1	class_name Main
2	extends Node2D
3	## Runs Level 1. It places Rudy, keeps the camera on him, and runs the level's
4	## states (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, STORYBOARD.md panels 1 and 4–7):
5	## - TITLE: the game opens on the start of the level with the title on top
6	##   (UI-TITLE) and Rudy idle, out of the player's control; the hearts are
7	##   hidden. Enter fades the title out and the hearts in, and play starts on the
8	##   same screen. The title shows once each time the game starts: Enter on the
9	##   end card plays again without it;
10	## - PLAYING;
11	## - DYING: a fall below a cliff, which costs a heart, or a hit that takes his
12	##   last heart. After a fade every monster is back where it started, even the
13	##   defeated ones, and so is the sword-and-shield pickup. After a fall that leaves him hearts, Rudy gets back up at
14	##   the last checkpoint, the lit waystone or else the start, with the hearts he
15	##   has left. Once his last heart is gone, by a hit or a fall, the level starts
16	##   over from the opening: he is at the start with full hearts, and the
17	##   waystone is dark;
18	## - COMPLETE: entered once, on the teleport circle. Input stops, Rudy
19	##   celebrates, the light rises, the camera pulls back, and the screen fades to
20	##   the end card, where Enter plays the level again from the opening.
21	## The camera follows Rudy sideways only, so the ground stays at the same height
22	## on screen and a fall drops him out of the frame. It shakes briefly on a hit.
23	##
24	## In play, Esc pauses everything but the music, which drops 12 dB and keeps
25	## its place, and shows "Paused"; Esc again resumes. Only in play: not on the
26	## title, through a death and the respawn, or from the teleport circle on.
27	## SystemKeys reads the key, since this node stops while the game is paused.
28	##
29	## The music (Music, CHANGE-BRIEF.md): it starts on the title and plays on when
30	## Enter starts play; it dips under a hit and through a death and the respawn,
31	## and never restarts from the top; on the teleport circle it fades out, and
32	## the end card is silent. A fall plays the hurt sound as he crosses the kill
33	## line, since it costs a heart.
34	
35	signal restart_requested ## only when Main is not the current scene, as in the checks
36	
37	enum State { TITLE, PLAYING, DYING, COMPLETE }
38	
39	const KILL_Y := 1300.0 ## below this line he has fallen out of the level
40	const FALL_HOLD := 0.25 ## s after he crosses the kill line, before the fade
41	const DEFEAT_HOLD := 0.8 ## s in CHAR-DEFEAT before the fade
42	const FADE_TIME := 0.35 ## s each way
43	const CELEBRATE_TIME := 2.0 ## s on the circle before the fade to the end card
44	const END_ZOOM := Vector2(0.8, 0.8)
45	const ZOOM_TIME := 1.5
46	const SHAKE_TIME := 0.2 ## s the camera shakes on a hit
47	const SHAKE_PX := 8.0
48	
49	static var title_shown := false ## once the title has shown, a restart goes straight to play
50	
51	var state := State.PLAYING
52	var checkpoint_name := "start"
53	
54	var _checkpoint: Vector2
55	var _end_card_shown := false
56	var _shake_left := 0.0
57	
58	@onready var _level: Node2D = $Level1
59	@onready var _rudy: Rudy = $Rudy
60	@onready var _camera: Camera2D = $Camera
61	@onready var _hud: Hud = $Hud
62	@onready var _waystone: Waystone = $Level1/Waystone
63	@onready var _portal: Portal = $Level1/Portal
64	@onready var _pickup: SwordPickup = $Level1/SwordPickup
65	
66	
67	func _ready() -> void:
68		_checkpoint = (_level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position
69		_rudy.global_position = _checkpoint
70		# The right-hand bound marks the end of the level.
71		var right_bound: Node2D = _level.get_node("Bounds/Right")
72		_camera.limit_right = roundi(right_bound.global_position.x)
73		_snap_camera()
74		_waystone.activated.connect(_on_waystone_activated)
75		_portal.reached.connect(_on_portal_reached)
76		_rudy.hit.connect(_on_rudy_hit)
77		_rudy.defeated.connect(_on_rudy_defeated)
78		_hud.track(_rudy)
79		Music.start()
80		if not title_shown:
81			state = State.TITLE
82			_rudy.mode = Rudy.Mode.WAITING
83			_hud.show_title()
84		_show_status()
85	
86	
87	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
88		_camera.position.x = _rudy.global_position.x
89		if state == State.PLAYING and _rudy.global_position.y > KILL_Y:
90			_die(&"fall")
91	
92	
93	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
94		if _shake_left > 0.0:
95			_shake_left -= delta
96			var shaking := _shake_left > 0.0
97			_camera.offset = Vector2(randf_range(-SHAKE_PX, SHAKE_PX), randf_range(-SHAKE_PX, SHAKE_PX)) if shaking else Vector2.ZERO
98		if state == State.TITLE and Input.is_action_just_pressed(&"restart"):
99			_start_play()
100		if _end_card_shown and Input.is_action_just_pressed(&"restart"):
101			_end_card_shown = false
102			_restart()
103	
104	
105	## Enter on the title: it fades out, the hearts fade in, and he is the player's.
106	func _start_play() -> void:
107		title_shown = true
108		state = State.PLAYING
109		_rudy.mode = Rudy.Mode.PLAY
110		_hud.hide_title(FADE_TIME)
111		_show_status()
112	
113	
114	## A fall below a cliff, or a defeat at zero hearts. Once his last heart is
115	## gone, the level starts over from the opening.
116	func _die(cause: StringName) -> void:
117		state = State.DYING # set first, so the kill line ignores him from now on
118		var start_over := true # a defeat: his last heart is gone
119		if cause == &"fall":
120			start_over = _rudy.fall_out() # only if the fall took his last heart
121			Sfx.play(&"hurt")
122		Music.dip(&"death", Music.DEATH_DIP)
123		_show_status()
124		await get_tree().create_timer(FALL_HOLD if cause == &"fall" else DEFEAT_HOLD).timeout
125		await _hud.fade_to(1.0, FADE_TIME)
126		if start_over:
127			_back_to_the_opening()
128		_rudy.respawn_at(_checkpoint, start_over)
129		for monster in _level.get_node("Enemies").get_children():
130			monster.reset()
131		_pickup.reset() # he gets back up without gear, so the pickup is back where it was
132		_shake_left = 0.0
133		_camera.offset = Vector2.ZERO
134		_snap_camera()
135		await _hud.fade_to(0.0, FADE_TIME)
136		if _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.RESPAWNING:
137			await _rudy.respawned
138		state = State.PLAYING
139		Music.end_dip(&"death")
140		_show_status()
141	
142	
143	## As if the level had just begun: the start is the checkpoint again, and the
144	## waystone is dark.
145	func _back_to_the_opening() -> void:
146		_checkpoint = (_level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position
147		checkpoint_name = "start"
148		_waystone.reset()
149	
150	
151	## Esc: pauses play, or resumes it. Only in play.
152	func toggle_pause() -> void:
153		var tree := get_tree()
154		if tree.paused:
155			tree.paused = false
156			Music.end_dip(&"pause")
157			_hud.show_paused(false)
158		elif state == State.PLAYING:
159			tree.paused = true
160			Music.dip(&"pause", Music.PAUSE_DIP)
161			_hud.show_paused(true)
162	
163	
164	func is_paused() -> bool:
165		return get_tree().paused
166	
167	
168	func _on_rudy_hit() -> void:
169		_shake_left = SHAKE_TIME
170		Music.dip(&"hurt", Music.HURT_DIP, Music.HURT_TIME)
171	
172	
173	func _on_rudy_defeated() -> void:
174		if state == State.PLAYING:
175			_die(&"defeat")
176	
177	
178	func _on_waystone_activated(waystone: Waystone) -> void:
179		_checkpoint = waystone.spawn_point.global_position
180		checkpoint_name = "waystone"
181		_show_status()
182	
183	
184	func _on_portal_reached() -> void:
185		if state != State.PLAYING:
186			return
187		state = State.COMPLETE # entered once; input stops
188		_rudy.celebrate()
189		Sfx.play(&"portal")
190		Music.fade_out()
191		_show_status()
192		_portal.light_up(CELEBRATE_TIME)
193		create_tween().tween_property(_camera, "zoom", END_ZOOM, ZOOM_TIME).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)
194		await get_tree().create_timer(CELEBRATE_TIME).timeout
195		await _hud.fade_to(1.0, FADE_TIME)
196		_hud.show_end_card(FADE_TIME) # Enter works from its first frame
197		_end_card_shown = true
198	
199	
200	## A level that goes away never leaves the game paused.
201	func _exit_tree() -> void:
202		if get_tree().paused:
203			get_tree().paused = false
204			Music.end_dip(&"pause")
205	
206	
207	func _restart() -> void:
208		if get_tree().current_scene == self:
209			get_tree().reload_current_scene()
210		else:
211			restart_requested.emit()
212	
213	
214	func _snap_camera() -> void:
215		_camera.position.x = _rudy.global_position.x
216		_camera.reset_smoothing()
217	
218	
219	func _show_status() -> void:
220		_hud.set_status("%s, checkpoint: %s" % [State.keys()[state], checkpoint_name])
221

## and never restarts from the top; on the teleport circle it fades out, and
## the end card is silent. A fall plays the hurt sound as he crosses the kill
## line, since it costs a heart.

signal restart_requested ## only when Main is not the current scene, as in the checks

enum State { TITLE, PLAYING, DYING, COMPLETE }

const KILL_Y := 1300.0 ## below this line he has fallen out of the level
const FALL_HOLD := 0.25 ## s after he crosses the kill line, before the fade
const DEFEAT_HOLD := 0.8 ## s in CHAR-DEFEAT before the fade
const FADE_TIME := 0.35 ## s each way
const CELEBRATE_TIME := 2.0 ## s on the circle before the fade to the end card
const END_ZOOM := Vector2(0.8, 0.8)
const ZOOM_TIME := 1.5
const SHAKE_TIME := 0.2 ## s the camera shakes on a hit
const SHAKE_PX := 8.0

static var title_shown := false ## once the title has shown, a restart goes straight to play

var state := State.PLAYING
var checkpoint_name := "start"

var _checkpoint: Vector2
var _end_card_shown := false
var _shake_left := 0.0

@onready var _level: Node2D = $Level1
@onready var _rudy: Rudy = $Rudy
@onready var _camera: Camera2D = $Camera
@onready var _hud: Hud = $Hud
@onready var _waystone: Waystone = $Level1/Waystone
@onready var _portal: Portal = $Level1/Portal
@onready var _pickup: SwordPickup = $Level1/SwordPickup


func _ready() -> void:
	_checkpoint = (_level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position
	_rudy.global_position = _checkpoint
	# The right-hand bound marks the end of the level.
	var right_bound: Node2D = _level.get_node("Bounds/Right")
	_camera.limit_right = roundi(right_bound.global_position.x)
	_snap_camera()
	_waystone.activated.connect(_on_waystone_activated)
	_portal.reached.connect(_on_portal_reached)
	_rudy.hit.connect(_on_rudy_hit)
	_rudy.defeated.connect(_on_rudy_defeated)
	_hud.track(_rudy)
	Music.start()
	if not title_shown:
		state = State.TITLE
		_rudy.mode = Rudy.Mode.WAITING
		_hud.show_title()
	_show_status()


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_camera.position.x = _rudy.global_position.x
	if state == State.PLAYING and _rudy.global_position.y > KILL_Y:
		_die(&"fall")


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _shake_left > 0.0:
		_shake_left -= delta
		var shaking := _shake_left > 0.0
		_camera.offset = Vector2(randf_range(-SHAKE_PX, SHAKE_PX), randf_range(-SHAKE_PX, SHAKE_PX)) if shaking else Vector2.ZERO
	if state == State.TITLE and Input.is_action_just_pressed(&"restart"):
		_start_play()
	if _end_card_shown and Input.is_action_just_pressed(&"restart"):
		_end_card_shown = false
		_restart()


## Enter on the title: it fades out, the hearts fade in, and he is the player's.
func _start_play() -> void:
	title_shown = true
	state = State.PLAYING
	_rudy.mode = Rudy.Mode.PLAY
	_hud.hide_title(FADE_TIME)
	_show_status()


## A fall below a cliff, or a defeat at zero hearts. Once his last heart is
## gone, the level starts over from the opening.
func _die(cause: StringName) -> void:
	state = State.DYING # set first, so the kill line ignores him from now on
	var start_over := true # a defeat: his last heart is gone
	if cause == &"fall":
		start_over = _rudy.fall_out() # only if the fall took his last heart
		Sfx.play(&"hurt")
	Music.dip(&"death", Music.DEATH_DIP)
	_show_status()
	await get_tree().create_timer(FALL_HOLD if cause == &"fall" else DEFEAT_HOLD).timeout
	await _hud.fade_to(1.0, FADE_TIME)
	if start_over:
		_back_to_the_opening()
	_rudy.respawn_at(_checkpoint, start_over)
	for monster in _level.get_node("Enemies").get_children():
		monster.reset()
	_pickup.reset() # he gets back up without gear, so the pickup is back where it was
	_shake_left = 0.0
	_camera.offset = Vector2.ZERO
	_snap_camera()
	await _hud.fade_to(0.0, FADE_TIME)
	if _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.RESPAWNING:
		await _rudy.respawned
	state = State.PLAYING
	Music.end_dip(&"death")
	_show_status()


## As if the level had just begun: the start is the checkpoint again, and the
## waystone is dark.
func _back_to_the_opening() -> void:
	_checkpoint = (_level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position
	checkpoint_name = "start"
	_waystone.reset()


## Esc: pauses play, or resumes it. Only in play.
func toggle_pause() -> void:
	var tree := get_tree()
	if tree.paused:
		tree.paused = false
		Music.end_dip(&"pause")
		_hud.show_paused(false)
	elif state == State.PLAYING:
		tree.paused = true
		Music.dip(&"pause", Music.PAUSE_DIP)
		_hud.show_paused(true)


func is_paused() -> bool:
	return get_tree().paused


func _on_rudy_hit() -> void:
	_shake_left = SHAKE_TIME
	Music.dip(&"hurt", Music.HURT_DIP, Music.HURT_TIME)


func _on_rudy_defeated() -> void:
	if state == State.PLAYING:
		_die(&"defeat")


func _on_waystone_activated(waystone: Waystone) -> void:
	_checkpoint = waystone.spawn_point.global_position
	checkpoint_name = "waystone"
	_show_status()


func _on_portal_reached() -> void:
	if state != State.PLAYING:
		return
	state = State.COMPLETE # entered once; input stops
	_rudy.celebrate()
	Sfx.play(&"portal")
	Music.fade_out()
	_show_status()
	_portal.light_up(CELEBRATE_TIME)
	create_tween().tween_property(_camera, "zoom", END_ZOOM, ZOOM_TIME).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)
	await get_tree().create_timer(CELEBRATE_TIME).timeout
	await _hud.fade_to(1.0, FADE_TIME)
	_hud.show_end_card(FADE_TIME) # Enter works from its first frame
	_end_card_shown = true


## A level that goes away never leaves the game paused.
func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if get_tree().paused:
		get_tree().paused = false
		Music.end_dip(&"pause")


func _restart() -> void:
	if get_tree().current_scene == self:
		get_tree().reload_current_scene()
	else:
		restart_requested.emit()


func _snap_camera() -> void:
	_camera.position.x = _rudy.global_position.x
	_camera.reset_smoothing()


func _show_status() -> void:
	_hud.set_status("%s, checkpoint: %s" % [State.keys()[state], checkpoint_name])

1	extends Node
2	## Headless state checks for Effect B, the running dust trail (CHANGE-BRIEF.md,
3	## section 3, rules B1–B5). Run from this folder:
4	##   scripts/run-test.sh test_run_dust_state.tscn 60
5	## It plays Main through the real game loop: every run, stop, turn, jump, hit
6	## and pause comes from an input action, and it never calls the driver. Besides
7	## Main.title_shown, set before load so the title shows, the main sequence
8	## writes no game state: the only nodes it writes are RunDust's and DustTrail's
9	## visibility, for rule B4, which are presentation nodes. D14 alone writes
10	## Rudy's place once, as checks.gd's _teleport does, to put him by a cliff.
11	## A recorder reads, each physics tick, the brief's condition from Rudy and
12	## RunDust's state. This node runs before Main's nodes in each tick, so what it
13	## reads is the state at the end of the tick before, with the condition and
14	## emitting read at the same moment: a driver a tick late would show as a
15	## mismatch at every edge. A visibility write is made by the recorder right
16	## after it reads, so no sample falls between that write and the driver's tick.
17	## Headless, the dummy renderer draws nothing and runs no particle process, so
18	## these checks read node state only (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
19	## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.
20	
21	const MAIN := preload("res://app/main.tscn")
22	const OFFSET := Vector2(0, -4) ## the emitter's place relative to Rudy's soles (B2)
23	
24	
25	## One physics tick as the recorder saw it.
26	class Sample:
27		var tick := 0
28		var cond := false ## the brief's condition: in play, on the floor, |velocity.x| > 1
29		var emitting := false
30		var shown := false ## RunDust.is_visible_in_tree()
31		var dust_pos: Vector2
32		var rudy_pos: Vector2
33		var vx := 0.0
34		var on_floor := false
35		var mode := 0
36		var facing := 0
37		var amount := 0
38		var ratio := 0.0
39	
40	
41	var _failures := 0
42	var _main: Main
43	var _rudy: Rudy
44	var _dust_trail: Node2D
45	var _run_dust: GPUParticles2D
46	var _tick := 0
47	var _samples: Array[Sample] = []
48	var _pending := Callable() ## a write the recorder makes right after it reads
49	
50	
51	func _ready() -> void:
52		await _run()
53		print("all checks passed" if _failures == 0 else "%d check(s) FAILED" % _failures)
54		get_tree().quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)
55	
56	
57	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
58		if not is_instance_valid(_rudy):
59			return
60		_tick += 1
61		var s := Sample.new()
62		s.tick = _tick
63		s.vx = _rudy.velocity.x
64		s.on_floor = _rudy.is_on_floor()
65		s.mode = _rudy.mode
66		s.facing = _rudy.facing
67		s.cond = s.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and s.on_floor and absf(s.vx) > 1.0
68		s.emitting = _run_dust.emitting
69		s.shown = _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree()
70		s.dust_pos = _run_dust.global_position
71		s.rudy_pos = _rudy.global_position
72		s.amount = _run_dust.amount
73		s.ratio = _run_dust.amount_ratio
74		_samples.append(s)
75		if _pending.is_valid():
76			var write := _pending
77			_pending = Callable()
78			write.call()
79	
80	
81	func _run() -> void:
82		# D1: on load, with the title showing.
83		Main.title_shown = false
84		_main = MAIN.instantiate()
85		add_child(_main)
86		_rudy = _main.get_node("Rudy")
87		_dust_trail = _main.get_node("DustTrail")
88		_run_dust = _dust_trail.get_node("RunDust")
89		Input.action_press(&"move_right")
90		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _samples.size() >= 30, 40)
91		Input.action_release(&"move_right")
92		var window := _samples.slice(0)
93		_check("D1 on load and on the title, move_right held 30 ticks: emitting false every tick",
94			window.size() >= 30 and _count(window, "emitting") == 0 and _main.state == Main.State.TITLE
95			and _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.WAITING,
96			"%d ticks, %d emitting, state %s, mode %s"
97			% [window.size(), _count(window, "emitting"), Main.State.keys()[_main.state], Rudy.Mode.keys()[_rudy.mode]])
98	
99		# D2: play starts; he stands.
100		await _tap(&"restart")
101		var i := _samples.size()
102		await _frames(30)
103		window = _samples.slice(i)
104		_check("D2 play started, standing 30 ticks: condition and emitting false every tick",
105			window.size() >= 30 and _count(window, "cond") == 0 and _count(window, "emitting") == 0
106			and _main.state == Main.State.PLAYING,
107			"%d ticks, condition %d, emitting %d, state %s"
108			% [window.size(), _count(window, "cond"), _count(window, "emitting"), Main.State.keys()[_main.state]])
109	
110		# D3: he starts running right.
111		i = _samples.size()
112		Input.action_press(&"move_right")
113		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x >= _rudy.run_speed, 30)
114		await _frames(5)
115		var cond_up := _edges(i, "cond", true)
116		var emit_up := _edges(i, "emitting", true)
117		_check("D3 move_right held: one rising edge of the condition and one of emitting, on the same tick",
118			cond_up.size() == 1 and cond_up == emit_up,
119			"condition rose on %s, emitting on %s" % [cond_up, emit_up])
120	
121		# D7: still running right, he jumps and lands.
122		i = _samples.size()
123		await _tap(&"jump")
124		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.is_on_floor(), 90)
125		await _frames(5)
126		var take_off := _first(i, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return not s.on_floor)
127		var landing := _first(take_off + 1, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return s.on_floor) if take_off >= 0 else -1
128		if take_off > 0 and landing > 0:
129			var air := _samples.slice(take_off, landing)
130			var before := _samples[take_off - 1]
131			_check("D7 a jump while running: both false from take-off through the air, both true again on the landing tick",
132				before.cond and before.emitting and _count(air, "cond") == 0 and _count(air, "emitting") == 0
133				and air.size() >= 30 and _samples[landing].cond and _samples[landing].emitting
134				and _edges(i, "emitting", false) == [_samples[take_off].tick]
135				and _edges(i, "emitting", true) == [_samples[landing].tick]
136				and _edges(i, "cond", true) == _edges(i, "emitting", true),
137				"take-off tick %d, landing tick %d: %d air ticks, emitting in the air %d; emitting fell on %s, rose on %s; condition rose on %s"
138				% [_samples[take_off].tick, _samples[landing].tick, air.size(), _count(air, "emitting"),
139				_edges(i, "emitting", false), _edges(i, "emitting", true), _edges(i, "cond", true)])
140		else:
141			_check("D7 a jump while running: both false from take-off through the air, both true again on the landing tick",
142				false, "take-off index %d, landing index %d" % [take_off, landing])
143	
144		# D5: he lets go and slows to a stop.
145		i = _samples.size()
146		Input.action_release(&"move_right")
147		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 30)
148		await _frames(5)
149		var cond_down := _edges(i, "cond", false)
150		var emit_down := _edges(i, "emitting", false)
151		var at := _index_of_tick(cond_down[0]) if cond_down.size() == 1 else -1
152		_check("D5 move_right released: emitting falls on the tick the condition falls, once speed is <= 1 px/s",
153			cond_down.size() == 1 and cond_down == emit_down and at > 0
154			and absf(_samples[at].vx) <= 1.0 and absf(_samples[at - 1].vx) > 1.0,
155			"condition fell on %s, emitting on %s; speed then %.2f, the tick before %.2f"
156			% [cond_down, emit_down, absf(_samples[at].vx) if at > 0 else -1.0,
157			absf(_samples[at - 1].vx) if at > 0 else -1.0])
158	
159		# D6: running right, he turns left.
160		Input.action_press(&"move_right")
161		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x >= _rudy.run_speed, 30)
162		await _frames(3)
163		i = _samples.size()
164		Input.action_release(&"move_right")
165		Input.action_press(&"move_left")
166		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x <= -_rudy.run_speed, 40)
167		await _frames(3)
168		var turn := _first(i, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return s.facing == -1)
169		cond_up = _edges(i, "cond", true)
170		emit_up = _edges(i, "emitting", true)
171		if turn > 0:
172			var gap: int = (cond_up[0] - _samples[turn].tick) if cond_up.size() == 1 else -1
173			_check("D6 a turn while running: both false on the turn tick and through the hold, both true again on the same tick once he moves left",
174				_samples[turn - 1].cond and _samples[turn - 1].emitting and not _samples[turn].cond
175				and not _samples[turn].emitting and absf(_samples[turn].vx) <= 1.0
176				and _edges(i, "cond", false) == [_samples[turn].tick] and _edges(i, "emitting", false) == [_samples[turn].tick]
177				and cond_up.size() == 1 and cond_up == emit_up and gap >= 5,
178				"turn tick %d, speed then %.2f; condition fell on %s, rose on %s; emitting fell on %s, rose on %s; %d ticks still"
179				% [_samples[turn].tick, absf(_samples[turn].vx), _edges(i, "cond", false), cond_up,
180				_edges(i, "emitting", false), emit_up, gap])
181		else:
182			_check("D6 a turn while running: both false on the turn tick and through the hold, both true again on the same tick once he moves left",
183				false, "no turn recorded")
184	
185		# D8: still running left, the tree pauses and resumes.
186		await _tap(&"pause")
187		var paused := _main.is_paused()
188		var emitting_paused := _run_dust.emitting
189		var processing_paused := _run_dust.can_process()
190		var pos_paused := _run_dust.global_position
191		var n := _samples.size()
192		await _frames(30)
193		var emitting_later := _run_dust.emitting
194		var pos_later := _run_dust.global_position
195		var recorded := _samples.size() - n
196		await _tap(&"pause")
197		var resumed := not _main.is_paused()
198		_check("D8 paused while running for 30 ticks: emitting stays true, the node does not process, the emitter does not move; on resume it processes and emits",
199			paused and emitting_paused and emitting_later and not processing_paused and pos_paused == pos_later
200			and recorded == 0 and resumed and _run_dust.can_process() and _run_dust.emitting,
201			"paused %s; emitting %s then %s; processing %s; at %s then %s; ticks recorded while paused %d; resumed %s, processing %s, emitting %s"
202			% [paused, emitting_paused, emitting_later, processing_paused, pos_paused, pos_later, recorded,
203			resumed, _run_dust.can_process(), _run_dust.emitting])
204	
205		# D9: still running left, RunDust is hidden and shown.
206		await _hide_and_show(_run_dust,
207			"D9 RunDust hidden while running: emitting false on the next tick; shown again: emitting true on the next tick")
208	
209		# D10: the same with its parent, DustTrail.
210		await _hide_and_show(_dust_trail,
211			"D10 DustTrail (its parent) hidden while running: not visible in the tree, emitting false; shown again: emitting true")
212		Input.action_release(&"move_left")
213		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 30)
214		await _frames(2) # so the recorder has seen the stop before D13's window opens
215	
216		# D13: he runs right into SpikesA and is knocked back.
217		i = _samples.size()
218		Input.action_press(&"move_right")
219		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.HURT, 240)
220		Input.action_release(&"move_right")
221		await _frames(2)
222		var hit := _first(i, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return s.mode == Rudy.Mode.HURT)
223		if hit > 0:
224			_check("D13 a hit on SpikesA while running: condition and emitting fall together on the hit tick",
225				_samples[hit - 1].cond and _samples[hit - 1].emitting and not _samples[hit].cond
226				and not _samples[hit].emitting and _samples[hit].vx < 0.0
227				and _edges(i, "emitting", false) == [_samples[hit].tick] and _edges(i, "cond", false) == [_samples[hit].tick],
228				"hit tick %d, knocked back at %.0f px/s; condition fell on %s, emitting on %s"
229				% [_samples[hit].tick, _samples[hit].vx, _edges(i, "cond", false), _edges(i, "emitting", false)])
230		else:
231			_check("D13 a hit on SpikesA while running: condition and emitting fall together on the hit tick",
232				false, "no hit recorded; at x %.0f" % _rudy.global_position.x)
233		await _wait_until(func() -> bool:
234			return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and _rudy.is_on_floor() and _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 120)
235	
236		# D14: he runs off the cliff at the end of Segment 1, falls out and respawns.
237		var ground_y := (_main.get_node("Level1/StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position.y
238		_rudy.global_position = Vector2(4200.0, ground_y)
239		_rudy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
240		await _frames(2)
241		i = _samples.size()
242		Input.action_press(&"move_right")
243		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.FALLEN, 120)
244		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.RESPAWNING, 180)
245		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY, 180)
246		await _wait_until(_condition, 30)
247		await _frames(3)
248		Input.action_release(&"move_right")
249		var leave := _first(i, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return not s.on_floor)
250		var back := _first(leave + 1, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return s.cond) if leave >= 0 else -1
251		if leave > 0 and back > 0:
252			var out := _samples.slice(leave, back)
253			var jumps: Array[int] = []
254			for j in range(leave, back + 1):
255				if _samples[j].dust_pos.distance_to(_samples[j - 1].dust_pos) > 200.0:
256					jumps.append(j)
257			var jump_quiet := jumps.size() == 1 and not _samples[jumps[0]].emitting and not _samples[jumps[0] - 1].emitting
258			var modes := {}
259			for s in out:
260				modes[Rudy.Mode.keys()[s.mode]] = true
261			_check("D14 off a cliff, out and respawned, holding move_right: emitting false from leaving the floor until control returns, the emitter's jump to the checkpoint on a tick without emitting, emitting true when he runs again",
262				_samples[leave - 1].cond and _samples[leave - 1].emitting and _count(out, "emitting") == 0
263				and modes.has("FALLEN") and modes.has("RESPAWNING") and jump_quiet
264				and _samples[back].emitting and _edges(leave, "emitting", true) == [_samples[back].tick],
265				"left the floor on tick %d, ran again on tick %d: %d ticks out, emitting %d; modes %s; emitter jumps on ticks %s, emitting then %s; emitting rose on %s"
266				% [_samples[leave].tick, _samples[back].tick, out.size(), _count(out, "emitting"), modes.keys(),
267				jumps.map(func(j: int) -> int: return _samples[j].tick),
268				jumps.map(func(j: int) -> bool: return _samples[j].emitting or _samples[j - 1].emitting),
269				_edges(leave, "emitting", true)])
270		else:
271			_check("D14 off a cliff, out and respawned: emitting false from leaving the floor until control returns",
272				false, "left the floor at index %d, ran again at index %d; mode %s"
273				% [leave, back, Rudy.Mode.keys()[_rudy.mode]])
274		await _frames(10)
275	
276		# D4: on every tick the condition holds, the emitter is at his soles + (0, -4).
277		var running := 0
278		var worst := 0.0
279		for s in _samples:
280			if s.cond:
281				running += 1
282				worst = maxf(worst, s.dust_pos.distance_to(s.rudy_pos + OFFSET))
283		_check("D4 on every tick the condition holds, the emitter is at Rudy + (0, -4) within 1 px",
284			running > 0 and worst <= 1.0, "%d ticks, largest error %.3f px" % [running, worst])
285	
286		# D11: the whole run.
287		var mismatches := 0
288		var wrong_amount := 0
289		var speeds := {}
290		for s in _samples:
291			if s.emitting != (s.cond and s.shown):
292				mismatches += 1
293			if s.amount != 40 or s.ratio != 1.0:
294				wrong_amount += 1
295			speeds[snappedf(absf(s.vx), 0.01)] = true
296		_check("D11 on every recorded tick, emitting == (condition and visible in the tree); amount 40 and amount_ratio 1.0 throughout",
297			mismatches == 0 and wrong_amount == 0 and speeds.size() >= 2,
298			"%d ticks, %d mismatches, %d with another amount or ratio, %d distinct speeds"
299			% [_samples.size(), mismatches, wrong_amount, speeds.size()])
300	
301		# D12: where the emitter lives.
302		var look: Node = _rudy.get_node("Look")
303		_check("D12 RunDust's parent is DustTrail, DustTrail comes before Rudy in Main, and neither Rudy nor Look is its ancestor",
304			_run_dust.get_parent() == _dust_trail and _dust_trail.get_parent() == _main
305			and _dust_trail.get_index() < _rudy.get_index()
306			and not _rudy.is_ancestor_of(_run_dust) and not look.is_ancestor_of(_run_dust),
307			"parent %s, DustTrail index %d, Rudy index %d" % [_run_dust.get_parent().name, _dust_trail.get_index(), _rudy.get_index()])
308	
309	
310	## While he runs: hides `node`, checks, shows it again, checks (rule B4).
311	func _hide_and_show(node: CanvasItem, what: String) -> void:
312		var held := _condition()
313		_pending = func() -> void: node.visible = false
314		await _frames(1)
315		var hidden_ok := _condition() and not _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree() and not _run_dust.emitting
316		var detail := "hidden: condition %s, visible in tree %s, emitting %s" % [
317			_condition(), _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree(), _run_dust.emitting]
318		await _frames(5)
319		var stayed_off := not _run_dust.emitting
320		_pending = func() -> void: node.visible = true
321		await _frames(1)
322		var shown_ok := _condition() and _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree() and _run_dust.emitting
323		detail += "; 5 ticks later emitting %s; shown: condition %s, visible in tree %s, emitting %s" % [
324			not stayed_off, _condition(), _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree(), _run_dust.emitting]
325		_check(what, held and hidden_ok and stayed_off and shown_ok, detail)
326	
327	
328	## The brief's condition, read from Rudy now.
329	func _condition() -> bool:
330		return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and _rudy.is_on_floor() and absf(_rudy.velocity.x) > 1.0
331	
332	
333	func _count(samples: Array[Sample], key: String) -> int:
334		var count := 0
335		for s in samples:
336			if s.get(key):
337				count += 1
338		return count
339	
340	
341	## The ticks, from sample index `from` on, on which `key` rose (or fell).
342	func _edges(from: int, key: String, rising: bool) -> Array[int]:
343		var ticks: Array[int] = []
344		for j in range(maxi(from, 1), _samples.size()):
345			var was: bool = _samples[j - 1].get(key)
346			var now: bool = _samples[j].get(key)
347			if now != was and now == rising:
348				ticks.append(_samples[j].tick)
349		return ticks
350	
351	
352	## The index of the first sample from `from` on that matches, or -1.
353	func _first(from: int, matches: Callable) -> int:
354		for j in range(from, _samples.size()):
355			if matches.call(_samples[j]):
356				return j
357		return -1
358	
359	
360	func _index_of_tick(tick: int) -> int:
361		for j in _samples.size():
362			if _samples[j].tick == tick:
363				return j
364		return -1
365	
366	
367	func _check(what: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
368		print("%s  %s%s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, "" if detail.is_empty() else "  (%s)" % detail])
369		if not ok:
370			_failures += 1
371	
372	
373	func _frames(n: int) -> void:
374		for i in n:
375			await get_tree().physics_frame
376	
377	
378	## Waits until `condition` is true, for at most `max_ticks`; returns the ticks waited.
379	func _wait_until(condition: Callable, max_ticks: int) -> int:
380		for t in max_ticks:
381			if condition.call():
382				return t
383			await get_tree().physics_frame
384		return max_ticks
385	
386	
387	func _tap(action: StringName) -> void:
388		Input.action_press(action)
389		await _frames(2)
390		Input.action_release(action)

extends Node
## Headless state checks for Effect B, the running dust trail (CHANGE-BRIEF.md,
## section 3, rules B1–B5). Run from this folder:
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_run_dust_state.tscn 60
## It plays Main through the real game loop: every run, stop, turn, jump, hit
## and pause comes from an input action, and it never calls the driver. Besides
## Main.title_shown, set before load so the title shows, the main sequence
## writes no game state: the only nodes it writes are RunDust's and DustTrail's
## visibility, for rule B4, which are presentation nodes. D14 alone writes
## Rudy's place once, as checks.gd's _teleport does, to put him by a cliff.
## A recorder reads, each physics tick, the brief's condition from Rudy and
## RunDust's state. This node runs before Main's nodes in each tick, so what it
## reads is the state at the end of the tick before, with the condition and
## emitting read at the same moment: a driver a tick late would show as a
## mismatch at every edge. A visibility write is made by the recorder right
## after it reads, so no sample falls between that write and the driver's tick.
## Headless, the dummy renderer draws nothing and runs no particle process, so
## these checks read node state only (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.

const MAIN := preload("res://app/main.tscn")
const OFFSET := Vector2(0, -4) ## the emitter's place relative to Rudy's soles (B2)


## One physics tick as the recorder saw it.
class Sample:
	var tick := 0
	var cond := false ## the brief's condition: in play, on the floor, |velocity.x| > 1
	var emitting := false
	var shown := false ## RunDust.is_visible_in_tree()
	var dust_pos: Vector2
	var rudy_pos: Vector2
	var vx := 0.0
	var on_floor := false
	var mode := 0
	var facing := 0
	var amount := 0
	var ratio := 0.0


var _failures := 0
var _main: Main
var _rudy: Rudy
var _dust_trail: Node2D
var _run_dust: GPUParticles2D
var _tick := 0
var _samples: Array[Sample] = []
var _pending := Callable() ## a write the recorder makes right after it reads


func _ready() -> void:
	await _run()
	print("all checks passed" if _failures == 0 else "%d check(s) FAILED" % _failures)
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_rudy):
		return
	_tick += 1
	var s := Sample.new()
	s.tick = _tick
	s.vx = _rudy.velocity.x
	s.on_floor = _rudy.is_on_floor()
	s.mode = _rudy.mode
	s.facing = _rudy.facing
	s.cond = s.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and s.on_floor and absf(s.vx) > 1.0
	s.emitting = _run_dust.emitting
	s.shown = _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree()
	s.dust_pos = _run_dust.global_position
	s.rudy_pos = _rudy.global_position
	s.amount = _run_dust.amount
	s.ratio = _run_dust.amount_ratio
	_samples.append(s)
	if _pending.is_valid():
		var write := _pending
		_pending = Callable()
		write.call()


func _run() -> void:
	# D1: on load, with the title showing.
	Main.title_shown = false
	_main = MAIN.instantiate()
	add_child(_main)
	_rudy = _main.get_node("Rudy")
	_dust_trail = _main.get_node("DustTrail")
	_run_dust = _dust_trail.get_node("RunDust")
	Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _samples.size() >= 30, 40)
	Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	var window := _samples.slice(0)
	_check("D1 on load and on the title, move_right held 30 ticks: emitting false every tick",
		window.size() >= 30 and _count(window, "emitting") == 0 and _main.state == Main.State.TITLE
		and _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.WAITING,
		"%d ticks, %d emitting, state %s, mode %s"
		% [window.size(), _count(window, "emitting"), Main.State.keys()[_main.state], Rudy.Mode.keys()[_rudy.mode]])

	# D2: play starts; he stands.
	await _tap(&"restart")
	var i := _samples.size()
	await _frames(30)
	window = _samples.slice(i)
	_check("D2 play started, standing 30 ticks: condition and emitting false every tick",
		window.size() >= 30 and _count(window, "cond") == 0 and _count(window, "emitting") == 0
		and _main.state == Main.State.PLAYING,
		"%d ticks, condition %d, emitting %d, state %s"
		% [window.size(), _count(window, "cond"), _count(window, "emitting"), Main.State.keys()[_main.state]])

	# D3: he starts running right.
	i = _samples.size()
	Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x >= _rudy.run_speed, 30)
	await _frames(5)
	var cond_up := _edges(i, "cond", true)
	var emit_up := _edges(i, "emitting", true)
	_check("D3 move_right held: one rising edge of the condition and one of emitting, on the same tick",
		cond_up.size() == 1 and cond_up == emit_up,
		"condition rose on %s, emitting on %s" % [cond_up, emit_up])

	# D7: still running right, he jumps and lands.
	i = _samples.size()
	await _tap(&"jump")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.is_on_floor(), 90)
	await _frames(5)
	var take_off := _first(i, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return not s.on_floor)
	var landing := _first(take_off + 1, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return s.on_floor) if take_off >= 0 else -1
	if take_off > 0 and landing > 0:
		var air := _samples.slice(take_off, landing)
		var before := _samples[take_off - 1]
		_check("D7 a jump while running: both false from take-off through the air, both true again on the landing tick",
			before.cond and before.emitting and _count(air, "cond") == 0 and _count(air, "emitting") == 0
			and air.size() >= 30 and _samples[landing].cond and _samples[landing].emitting
			and _edges(i, "emitting", false) == [_samples[take_off].tick]
			and _edges(i, "emitting", true) == [_samples[landing].tick]
			and _edges(i, "cond", true) == _edges(i, "emitting", true),
			"take-off tick %d, landing tick %d: %d air ticks, emitting in the air %d; emitting fell on %s, rose on %s; condition rose on %s"
			% [_samples[take_off].tick, _samples[landing].tick, air.size(), _count(air, "emitting"),
			_edges(i, "emitting", false), _edges(i, "emitting", true), _edges(i, "cond", true)])
	else:
		_check("D7 a jump while running: both false from take-off through the air, both true again on the landing tick",
			false, "take-off index %d, landing index %d" % [take_off, landing])

	# D5: he lets go and slows to a stop.
	i = _samples.size()
	Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 30)
	await _frames(5)
	var cond_down := _edges(i, "cond", false)
	var emit_down := _edges(i, "emitting", false)
	var at := _index_of_tick(cond_down[0]) if cond_down.size() == 1 else -1
	_check("D5 move_right released: emitting falls on the tick the condition falls, once speed is <= 1 px/s",
		cond_down.size() == 1 and cond_down == emit_down and at > 0
		and absf(_samples[at].vx) <= 1.0 and absf(_samples[at - 1].vx) > 1.0,
		"condition fell on %s, emitting on %s; speed then %.2f, the tick before %.2f"
		% [cond_down, emit_down, absf(_samples[at].vx) if at > 0 else -1.0,
		absf(_samples[at - 1].vx) if at > 0 else -1.0])

	# D6: running right, he turns left.
	Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x >= _rudy.run_speed, 30)
	await _frames(3)
	i = _samples.size()
	Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	Input.action_press(&"move_left")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x <= -_rudy.run_speed, 40)
	await _frames(3)
	var turn := _first(i, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return s.facing == -1)
	cond_up = _edges(i, "cond", true)
	emit_up = _edges(i, "emitting", true)
	if turn > 0:
		var gap: int = (cond_up[0] - _samples[turn].tick) if cond_up.size() == 1 else -1
		_check("D6 a turn while running: both false on the turn tick and through the hold, both true again on the same tick once he moves left",
			_samples[turn - 1].cond and _samples[turn - 1].emitting and not _samples[turn].cond
			and not _samples[turn].emitting and absf(_samples[turn].vx) <= 1.0
			and _edges(i, "cond", false) == [_samples[turn].tick] and _edges(i, "emitting", false) == [_samples[turn].tick]
			and cond_up.size() == 1 and cond_up == emit_up and gap >= 5,
			"turn tick %d, speed then %.2f; condition fell on %s, rose on %s; emitting fell on %s, rose on %s; %d ticks still"
			% [_samples[turn].tick, absf(_samples[turn].vx), _edges(i, "cond", false), cond_up,
			_edges(i, "emitting", false), emit_up, gap])
	else:
		_check("D6 a turn while running: both false on the turn tick and through the hold, both true again on the same tick once he moves left",
			false, "no turn recorded")

	# D8: still running left, the tree pauses and resumes.
	await _tap(&"pause")
	var paused := _main.is_paused()
	var emitting_paused := _run_dust.emitting
	var processing_paused := _run_dust.can_process()
	var pos_paused := _run_dust.global_position
	var n := _samples.size()
	await _frames(30)
	var emitting_later := _run_dust.emitting
	var pos_later := _run_dust.global_position
	var recorded := _samples.size() - n
	await _tap(&"pause")
	var resumed := not _main.is_paused()
	_check("D8 paused while running for 30 ticks: emitting stays true, the node does not process, the emitter does not move; on resume it processes and emits",
		paused and emitting_paused and emitting_later and not processing_paused and pos_paused == pos_later
		and recorded == 0 and resumed and _run_dust.can_process() and _run_dust.emitting,
		"paused %s; emitting %s then %s; processing %s; at %s then %s; ticks recorded while paused %d; resumed %s, processing %s, emitting %s"
		% [paused, emitting_paused, emitting_later, processing_paused, pos_paused, pos_later, recorded,
		resumed, _run_dust.can_process(), _run_dust.emitting])

	# D9: still running left, RunDust is hidden and shown.
	await _hide_and_show(_run_dust,
		"D9 RunDust hidden while running: emitting false on the next tick; shown again: emitting true on the next tick")

	# D10: the same with its parent, DustTrail.
	await _hide_and_show(_dust_trail,
		"D10 DustTrail (its parent) hidden while running: not visible in the tree, emitting false; shown again: emitting true")
	Input.action_release(&"move_left")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 30)
	await _frames(2) # so the recorder has seen the stop before D13's window opens

	# D13: he runs right into SpikesA and is knocked back.
	i = _samples.size()
	Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.HURT, 240)
	Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	await _frames(2)
	var hit := _first(i, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return s.mode == Rudy.Mode.HURT)
	if hit > 0:
		_check("D13 a hit on SpikesA while running: condition and emitting fall together on the hit tick",
			_samples[hit - 1].cond and _samples[hit - 1].emitting and not _samples[hit].cond
			and not _samples[hit].emitting and _samples[hit].vx < 0.0
			and _edges(i, "emitting", false) == [_samples[hit].tick] and _edges(i, "cond", false) == [_samples[hit].tick],
			"hit tick %d, knocked back at %.0f px/s; condition fell on %s, emitting on %s"
			% [_samples[hit].tick, _samples[hit].vx, _edges(i, "cond", false), _edges(i, "emitting", false)])
	else:
		_check("D13 a hit on SpikesA while running: condition and emitting fall together on the hit tick",
			false, "no hit recorded; at x %.0f" % _rudy.global_position.x)
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool:
		return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and _rudy.is_on_floor() and _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 120)

	# D14: he runs off the cliff at the end of Segment 1, falls out and respawns.
	var ground_y := (_main.get_node("Level1/StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position.y
	_rudy.global_position = Vector2(4200.0, ground_y)
	_rudy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	await _frames(2)
	i = _samples.size()
	Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.FALLEN, 120)
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.RESPAWNING, 180)
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY, 180)
	await _wait_until(_condition, 30)
	await _frames(3)
	Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	var leave := _first(i, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return not s.on_floor)
	var back := _first(leave + 1, func(s: Sample) -> bool: return s.cond) if leave >= 0 else -1
	if leave > 0 and back > 0:
		var out := _samples.slice(leave, back)
		var jumps: Array[int] = []
		for j in range(leave, back + 1):
			if _samples[j].dust_pos.distance_to(_samples[j - 1].dust_pos) > 200.0:
				jumps.append(j)
		var jump_quiet := jumps.size() == 1 and not _samples[jumps[0]].emitting and not _samples[jumps[0] - 1].emitting
		var modes := {}
		for s in out:
			modes[Rudy.Mode.keys()[s.mode]] = true
		_check("D14 off a cliff, out and respawned, holding move_right: emitting false from leaving the floor until control returns, the emitter's jump to the checkpoint on a tick without emitting, emitting true when he runs again",
			_samples[leave - 1].cond and _samples[leave - 1].emitting and _count(out, "emitting") == 0
			and modes.has("FALLEN") and modes.has("RESPAWNING") and jump_quiet
			and _samples[back].emitting and _edges(leave, "emitting", true) == [_samples[back].tick],
			"left the floor on tick %d, ran again on tick %d: %d ticks out, emitting %d; modes %s; emitter jumps on ticks %s, emitting then %s; emitting rose on %s"
			% [_samples[leave].tick, _samples[back].tick, out.size(), _count(out, "emitting"), modes.keys(),
			jumps.map(func(j: int) -> int: return _samples[j].tick),
			jumps.map(func(j: int) -> bool: return _samples[j].emitting or _samples[j - 1].emitting),
			_edges(leave, "emitting", true)])
	else:
		_check("D14 off a cliff, out and respawned: emitting false from leaving the floor until control returns",
			false, "left the floor at index %d, ran again at index %d; mode %s"
			% [leave, back, Rudy.Mode.keys()[_rudy.mode]])
	await _frames(10)

	# D4: on every tick the condition holds, the emitter is at his soles + (0, -4).
	var running := 0
	var worst := 0.0
	for s in _samples:
		if s.cond:
			running += 1
			worst = maxf(worst, s.dust_pos.distance_to(s.rudy_pos + OFFSET))
	_check("D4 on every tick the condition holds, the emitter is at Rudy + (0, -4) within 1 px",
		running > 0 and worst <= 1.0, "%d ticks, largest error %.3f px" % [running, worst])

	# D11: the whole run.
	var mismatches := 0
	var wrong_amount := 0
	var speeds := {}
	for s in _samples:
		if s.emitting != (s.cond and s.shown):
			mismatches += 1
		if s.amount != 40 or s.ratio != 1.0:
			wrong_amount += 1
		speeds[snappedf(absf(s.vx), 0.01)] = true
	_check("D11 on every recorded tick, emitting == (condition and visible in the tree); amount 40 and amount_ratio 1.0 throughout",
		mismatches == 0 and wrong_amount == 0 and speeds.size() >= 2,
		"%d ticks, %d mismatches, %d with another amount or ratio, %d distinct speeds"
		% [_samples.size(), mismatches, wrong_amount, speeds.size()])

	# D12: where the emitter lives.
	var look: Node = _rudy.get_node("Look")
	_check("D12 RunDust's parent is DustTrail, DustTrail comes before Rudy in Main, and neither Rudy nor Look is its ancestor",
		_run_dust.get_parent() == _dust_trail and _dust_trail.get_parent() == _main
		and _dust_trail.get_index() < _rudy.get_index()
		and not _rudy.is_ancestor_of(_run_dust) and not look.is_ancestor_of(_run_dust),
		"parent %s, DustTrail index %d, Rudy index %d" % [_run_dust.get_parent().name, _dust_trail.get_index(), _rudy.get_index()])


## While he runs: hides `node`, checks, shows it again, checks (rule B4).
func _hide_and_show(node: CanvasItem, what: String) -> void:
	var held := _condition()
	_pending = func() -> void: node.visible = false
	await _frames(1)
	var hidden_ok := _condition() and not _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree() and not _run_dust.emitting
	var detail := "hidden: condition %s, visible in tree %s, emitting %s" % [
		_condition(), _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree(), _run_dust.emitting]
	await _frames(5)
	var stayed_off := not _run_dust.emitting
	_pending = func() -> void: node.visible = true
	await _frames(1)
	var shown_ok := _condition() and _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree() and _run_dust.emitting
	detail += "; 5 ticks later emitting %s; shown: condition %s, visible in tree %s, emitting %s" % [
		not stayed_off, _condition(), _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree(), _run_dust.emitting]
	_check(what, held and hidden_ok and stayed_off and shown_ok, detail)


## The brief's condition, read from Rudy now.
func _condition() -> bool:
	return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and _rudy.is_on_floor() and absf(_rudy.velocity.x) > 1.0


func _count(samples: Array[Sample], key: String) -> int:
	var count := 0
	for s in samples:
		if s.get(key):
			count += 1
	return count


## The ticks, from sample index `from` on, on which `key` rose (or fell).
func _edges(from: int, key: String, rising: bool) -> Array[int]:
	var ticks: Array[int] = []
	for j in range(maxi(from, 1), _samples.size()):
		var was: bool = _samples[j - 1].get(key)
		var now: bool = _samples[j].get(key)
		if now != was and now == rising:
			ticks.append(_samples[j].tick)
	return ticks


## The index of the first sample from `from` on that matches, or -1.
func _first(from: int, matches: Callable) -> int:
	for j in range(from, _samples.size()):
		if matches.call(_samples[j]):
			return j
	return -1


func _index_of_tick(tick: int) -> int:
	for j in _samples.size():
		if _samples[j].tick == tick:
			return j
	return -1


func _check(what: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	print("%s  %s%s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, "" if detail.is_empty() else "  (%s)" % detail])
	if not ok:
		_failures += 1


func _frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await get_tree().physics_frame


## Waits until `condition` is true, for at most `max_ticks`; returns the ticks waited.
func _wait_until(condition: Callable, max_ticks: int) -> int:
	for t in max_ticks:
		if condition.call():
			return t
		await get_tree().physics_frame
	return max_ticks


func _tap(action: StringName) -> void:
	Input.action_press(action)
	await _frames(2)
	Input.action_release(action)

2	## Headless checks for the greybox. Run from the repository root:
3	##   Godot --headless --path game --fixed-fps 60 res://tests/checks.tscn
4	## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.
5	## Step 1a: the scenes have their nodes, Rudy's capsule matches the character
6	## sheet, his movement states, turning on the spot, the camera, and the jump
7	## sound's guard (one Sfx "jump" per takeoff, CHANGE-BRIEF.md).
8	## Step 1b: the layout, a fall below a cliff, the respawn at the last
9	## checkpoint, the waystone, the teleport circle and the end card, a clean
10	## route from the opening to the circle, and how forgiving the widest cliff is.
11	## Sounds counted: "fall", "checkpoint", "portal", each once per event.
12	## Step 1c: hearts, spikes, goblins, the stomp, invulnerability, knockback, the
13	## camera shake, defeat at zero hearts, and every monster back after a death.
14	## Sounds counted: "hurt" once per heart lost, "stomp" once per goblin stomped.
15	## Step 1d: the sword-and-shield pickup, the sword form, the slash and its
16	## reach, the gear knocked away by a hit, and the pickup back after a death.
17	## Sounds counted: "pickup" once per pickup, "slash" once per swing.
18	## Step 2a: Rudy's generated frames: every frame in frames.json is in his look
19	## at the canvas size, drawn with its body origin on his and at 1/density, with
20	## mipmaps and the outline material; and every pose he took in the checks above
21	## showed its own frame.
22	## Step 2b: Level 1's layers and ground: the ground art's walk line is the
23	## segments' top, each cliff face in the art is where the collision gap starts,
24	## the tiles meet the cliff pieces at the start of a period, the far layer
25	## fills the screen everywhere and during the pull-back, and the fields move at
26	## their share of the camera's motion in the same frame. After the 2b
27	## playtest, the spikes: each row stands between two tall wheat tufts, and the
28	## box that hurts covers the row of spikes and stops below the tips.
29	## Step 2c: the props, the goblin, the hearts and the end card: every sprite is
30	## drawn at 1/density from its props.json origin, with mipmaps; the outline is
31	## on the goblins and the spikes only; the goblin walks in two frames facing its
32	## way and is squashed when defeated; its box fits its art; the waystone's art
33	## lights; the flying gear is the pickup's art; and the end card's picture
34	## fades in under the text.
35	## Step 2d: the title over the opening: the game opens on it with Rudy idle,
36	## out of control, and the hearts hidden; Enter fades it out and the hearts in,
37	## and play starts on the same screen; it shows once per run.
38	## Step 3: the audio. The buses; each of the six sounds plays its own file on
39	## the SFX bus, and every sound the scripts play has a file (a fall now plays
40	## "hurt", and the waystone lights without a sound, so the checks above count
41	## its lights instead); each jump sound plays on the takeoff tick. The music:
42	## it starts on the title and Enter does not start it again; a hit dips it
43	## 6 dB for 0.6 s; Esc pauses play, and only play, with the music 12 dB down
44	## and the sound effects paused; a death dips it 9 dB until he is back in
45	## control, and neither a respawn nor a start-over starts it again; it fades
46	## out on the teleport circle, the end card is silent, and playing again starts
47	## it from the top. M and N mute the buses, even while paused, and with both
48	## muted the route from the opening runs the same, tick for tick.
49	## Step 5: every file the game's scenes, resources and scripts name by a res://
50	## path is in the project, so a fresh copy of the repository has every asset
51	## the slice uses; and, after my playtest, the debug line is hidden at the start.
52	## A headless run's audio driver never mixes, so a playing sound never ends or
53	## moves on: the checks read what the players were told to do, not what is
54	## heard, and the sounds still registered with the audio server are reported
55	## as leaked at exit.

## Headless checks for the greybox. Run from the repository root:
##   Godot --headless --path game --fixed-fps 60 res://tests/checks.tscn
## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.
## Step 1a: the scenes have their nodes, Rudy's capsule matches the character
## sheet, his movement states, turning on the spot, the camera, and the jump
## sound's guard (one Sfx "jump" per takeoff, CHANGE-BRIEF.md).
## Step 1b: the layout, a fall below a cliff, the respawn at the last
## checkpoint, the waystone, the teleport circle and the end card, a clean
## route from the opening to the circle, and how forgiving the widest cliff is.
## Sounds counted: "fall", "checkpoint", "portal", each once per event.
## Step 1c: hearts, spikes, goblins, the stomp, invulnerability, knockback, the
## camera shake, defeat at zero hearts, and every monster back after a death.
## Sounds counted: "hurt" once per heart lost, "stomp" once per goblin stomped.
## Step 1d: the sword-and-shield pickup, the sword form, the slash and its
## reach, the gear knocked away by a hit, and the pickup back after a death.
## Sounds counted: "pickup" once per pickup, "slash" once per swing.
## Step 2a: Rudy's generated frames: every frame in frames.json is in his look
## at the canvas size, drawn with its body origin on his and at 1/density, with
## mipmaps and the outline material; and every pose he took in the checks above
## showed its own frame.
## Step 2b: Level 1's layers and ground: the ground art's walk line is the
## segments' top, each cliff face in the art is where the collision gap starts,
## the tiles meet the cliff pieces at the start of a period, the far layer
## fills the screen everywhere and during the pull-back, and the fields move at
## their share of the camera's motion in the same frame. After the 2b
## playtest, the spikes: each row stands between two tall wheat tufts, and the
## box that hurts covers the row of spikes and stops below the tips.
## Step 2c: the props, the goblin, the hearts and the end card: every sprite is
## drawn at 1/density from its props.json origin, with mipmaps; the outline is
## on the goblins and the spikes only; the goblin walks in two frames facing its
## way and is squashed when defeated; its box fits its art; the waystone's art
## lights; the flying gear is the pickup's art; and the end card's picture
## fades in under the text.
## Step 2d: the title over the opening: the game opens on it with Rudy idle,
## out of control, and the hearts hidden; Enter fades it out and the hearts in,
## and play starts on the same screen; it shows once per run.
## Step 3: the audio. The buses; each of the six sounds plays its own file on
## the SFX bus, and every sound the scripts play has a file (a fall now plays
## "hurt", and the waystone lights without a sound, so the checks above count
## its lights instead); each jump sound plays on the takeoff tick. The music:
## it starts on the title and Enter does not start it again; a hit dips it
## 6 dB for 0.6 s; Esc pauses play, and only play, with the music 12 dB down
## and the sound effects paused; a death dips it 9 dB until he is back in
## control, and neither a respawn nor a start-over starts it again; it fades
## out on the teleport circle, the end card is silent, and playing again starts
## it from the top. M and N mute the buses, even while paused, and with both
## muted the route from the opening runs the same, tick for tick.
## Step 5: every file the game's scenes, resources and scripts name by a res://
## path is in the project, so a fresh copy of the repository has every asset
## the slice uses; and, after my playtest, the debug line is hidden at the start.
## A headless run's audio driver never mixes, so a playing sound never ends or
## moves on: the checks read what the players were told to do, not what is
## heard, and the sounds still registered with the audio server are reported
## as leaked at exit.

const MAIN := preload("res://app/main.tscn")
const REQUIRED_NODES := {
	"res://app/main.tscn": ["Level1", "Rudy", "Camera", "Hud", "Level1/Waystone", "Level1/Portal"],
	"res://content/rudy/rudy.tscn": ["Body", "Look", "SwordHitbox/Shape"],
	"res://content/level_1/level_1.tscn": [
		"Backdrop", "Backdrop/Far/Sky", "PitShade", "Ground/Segment1", "Ground/Segment2",
		"Ground/Segment3", "Hazards/SpikesA", "Hazards/SpikesB", "Enemies/GoblinA", "Enemies/GoblinB",
		"Enemies/GoblinC", "SwordPickup", "Waystone/SpawnPoint", "Portal", "Bounds/Left", "Bounds/Right", "StartPoint",
	],
	"res://content/goblin/goblin.tscn": ["Art", "Shape"],
	"res://content/level_1/spikes.tscn": ["Art", "Shape"],
	"res://content/level_1/waystone.tscn": ["Art", "Shape", "SpawnPoint"],
	"res://content/level_1/portal.tscn": ["Art", "Shape"],
	"res://content/sword_pickup/sword_pickup.tscn": ["Art", "Shape"],
	"res://ui/hud.tscn": [
		"Hearts", "Debug", "Title/Name", "Title/Level", "Title/Hint", "Fade", "EndCard/Picture",
		"EndCard/Lines/Title", "EndCard/Lines/Hint",
	],
}
const CLIFF_LEAD := 100.0 ## the route jumps this far before a cliff's edge
const SPIKES_LEAD := 100.0 ## ...before a row of spikes
const GOBLIN_LEAD := 220.0 ## ...before a live goblin, which may be walking toward him

var _failures := 0
var _main: Main
var _rudy: Rudy
var _camera: Camera2D
var _restart_requests := 0
# What the checks see Rudy do, measured from his motion rather than from Sfx.
var _takeoffs := 0
var _takeoff_ticks: Array[int] = [] # the ticks on which the checks saw a takeoff...
var _jump_sound_ticks: Array[int] = [] # ...and a jump sound
var _tick := 0
var _was_on_floor := true
var _lights := 0 # times the waystone lit
var _trail: Array[StringName] = [] # each pose, once per change
# Every pose Rudy took in all the checks, and any tick his look showed another pose's frame.
var _poses_taken: Dictionary[StringName, bool] = {}
var _frame_mismatches: PackedStringArray = []


func _ready() -> void:
	_check_scenes()
	_start_level()
	await _run_1a()
	await _run_1b()
	await _run_1c()
	await _run_1d()
	_run_2a()
	await _run_2b()
	await _run_2c()
	await _run_2d()
	await _run_3()
	_run_5()
	print("all checks passed" if _failures == 0 else "%d check(s) FAILED" % _failures)
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_rudy):
		return
	_tick += 1
	var on_floor := _rudy.is_on_floor()
	if _was_on_floor and not on_floor and _rudy.velocity.y < 0.0:
		_takeoffs += 1
		_takeoff_ticks.append(_tick)
	_was_on_floor = on_floor
	if Sfx.count(&"jump") > _jump_sound_ticks.size():
		_jump_sound_ticks.append(_tick)
	if _trail.is_empty() or _trail[-1] != _rudy.pose:
		_trail.append(_rudy.pose)
	_poses_taken[_rudy.pose] = true
	var shown := (_rudy.get_node("Look") as RudyLook).frame()
	if shown != RudyLook.FRAMES.get(_rudy.pose) and _frame_mismatches.size() < 5:
		_frame_mismatches.append("%s showed %s" % [_rudy.pose, shown.resource_path.get_file() if shown else "nothing"])


## A fresh level; without `with_title` it skips the title and starts in play.
func _start_level(with_title := false) -> void:
	Main.title_shown = not with_title
	_main = MAIN.instantiate()
	add_child(_main)
	_main.restart_requested.connect(_on_restart_requested)
	(_main.get_node("Level1/Waystone") as Waystone).activated.connect(func(_w: Waystone) -> void: _lights += 1)
	_rudy = _main.get_node("Rudy")
	_camera = _main.get_node("Camera")
	_was_on_floor = true


func _on_restart_requested() -> void:
	_restart_requests += 1


func _run_1a() -> void:
	# The movement checks run over the spikes and the first goblin; switch them off.
	_set_threats(false)
	var body: CollisionShape2D = _rudy.get_node("Body")
	var capsule := body.shape as CapsuleShape2D
	_check("the capsule is 40 x 136 px with its bottom on the soles",
		capsule.radius == 20.0 and capsule.height == 136.0 and body.position == Vector2(0, -68))

	await _frames(10)
	_check("Rudy starts on the ground at the start point",
		_rudy.is_on_floor() and is_equal_approx(_rudy.global_position.x, 300.0),
		"x %.1f, y %.1f" % [_rudy.global_position.x, _rudy.global_position.y])
	_check("standing still shows CHAR-IDLE", _rudy.pose == &"CHAR-IDLE", _rudy.pose)

	# Run right for two seconds.
	var x0 := _rudy.global_position.x
	_trail.clear()
	Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	await _frames(60)
	var ran := _rudy.global_position.x - x0
	_check("he runs right at about run_speed", ran > 0.9 * _rudy.run_speed and ran <= _rudy.run_speed,
		"%.0f px in 1 s" % ran)
	_check("the run alternates CHAR-RUN-A and CHAR-RUN-B",
		_trail.count(&"CHAR-RUN-A") >= 3 and _trail.count(&"CHAR-RUN-B") >= 3, _trail_text())
	await _frames(60)
	var view := _camera.get_screen_center_position()
	_check("the camera follows him sideways, less than his height behind, and keeps its height",
		absf(view.x - _rudy.global_position.x) < 160.0 and is_equal_approx(view.y, 540.0),
		"view centre %.0f, %.0f; Rudy x %.0f" % [view.x, view.y, _rudy.global_position.x])
	Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	await _frames(15)
	_check("he stops and shows CHAR-IDLE again",
		_rudy.pose == &"CHAR-IDLE" and _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, _rudy.pose)

	# One tap in place: one takeoff and one jump sound; RISE all the way down, then IDLE on landing.
	_reset_counts()
	var floor_y := _rudy.global_position.y
	# His height after each tick. A key pressed from inside a physics tick, as
	# here, counts from the next tick, so the takeoff is the first tick above 0.
	var heights: Array[float] = []
	Input.action_press(&"jump")
	for i in 90:
		await _frames(1)
		if i == 2:
			Input.action_release(&"jump")
		heights.append(floor_y - _rudy.global_position.y)
	_check("a tap jumps once, with one jump sound", _takeoffs == 1 and Sfx.count(&"jump") == 1, _counts_text())
	_check("a jump in place shows CHAR-RISE all the way down, then CHAR-IDLE",
		_trail == [&"CHAR-IDLE", &"CHAR-RISE", &"CHAR-IDLE"], _trail_text())
	var expected := _expected_jump()
	var takeoff := 0

func _run_1d() -> void:
	_main.queue_free()
	await _frames(1)
	_start_level()
	await _frames(5)
	var level: Node2D = _main.get_node("Level1")
	var pickup: SwordPickup = level.get_node("SwordPickup")
	var spikes: Spikes = level.get_node("Hazards/SpikesA")
	var goblin_b: Goblin = level.get_node("Enemies/GoblinB")
	var goblin_c: Goblin = level.get_node("Enemies/GoblinC")
	var start := (level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position
	var ground_y := start.y
	_check("Rudy starts without gear, in the default form",
		_rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.NONE and _rudy.pose == &"CHAR-IDLE", _rudy.pose)

	# Without the sword, slash does nothing.
	_reset_counts()
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _frames(20)
	_check("without the sword, slash does nothing", Sfx.count(&"slash") == 0 and not _rudy.is_slashing())

	# The pickup: the sword form, one pickup sound, and it is gone.
	_reset_counts()
	_teleport(Vector2(pickup.global_position.x - 200.0, ground_y))
	await _frames(2)
	await _hold_until(&"move_right", func() -> bool: return _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.SWORD, 120)
	await _frames(2)
	_check("touching the pickup gives him the sword and shield, with one pickup sound; it disappears",
		_rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.SWORD and Sfx.count(&"pickup") == 1 and pickup.taken and not pickup.visible,
		"pickup sounds %d" % Sfx.count(&"pickup"))
	_check("with the sword he shows the sword form's poses", String(_rudy.pose).begins_with("CHAR-SWORD-"), _rudy.pose)
	await _hold(&"move_left", 40)
	await _hold(&"move_right", 40)
	_check("crossing the pickup's place again gives nothing more", Sfx.count(&"pickup") == 1)

	# One tap: one swing and one slash sound; the swing ends after slash_time.
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.is_on_floor() and _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 60)
	_reset_counts()
	await _tap(&"slash")
	_check("a tap swings the sword once (CHAR-SWORD-SLASH), with one slash sound",
		Sfx.count(&"slash") == 1 and _rudy.pose == &"CHAR-SWORD-SLASH", "pose %s" % _rudy.pose)
	var swing_ticks: int = await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
	await _frames(1)
	_check("the swing ends after about slash_time, back in CHAR-SWORD-IDLE",
		_rudy.pose == &"CHAR-SWORD-IDLE" and absf((swing_ticks + 2) / 60.0 - _rudy.slash_time) <= 2.0 / 60.0,
		"%.2f s; pose %s" % [(swing_ticks + 2) / 60.0, _rudy.pose])

	# Holding the key: one swing. Mashing it: one sound per swing.
	_reset_counts()
	await _hold(&"slash", 60)
	await _frames(30)
	_check("holding slash swings once", Sfx.count(&"slash") == 1, "slash sounds %d" % Sfx.count(&"slash"))
	_reset_counts()
	var swings := 0
	var was_slashing := false
	for i in 120:
		if i % 2 == 0:
			Input.action_press(&"slash")
		else:
			Input.action_release(&"slash")
		await _frames(1)
		if _rudy.is_slashing() and not was_slashing:
			swings += 1
		was_slashing = _rudy.is_slashing()
	Input.action_release(&"slash")
	await _frames(30)
	_check("mashing slash: one slash sound per swing, and no swing starts during another",
		swings >= 3 and Sfx.count(&"slash") == swings and swings <= ceili(2.0 / _rudy.slash_time),
		"%d swings in 2 s, slash sounds %d" % [swings, Sfx.count(&"slash")])

	# A cut in reach defeats a goblin in one hit: no stomp sound, no hit.
	goblin_b.speed = 0.0
	goblin_c.speed = 0.0
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
	_reset_counts()
	_teleport(Vector2(goblin_b.global_position.x - 70.0, ground_y))
	await _frames(2)
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
	_check("a cut in reach defeats a goblin in one hit, with no stomp sound and no hit",
		goblin_b.dead and Sfx.count(&"stomp") == 0 and Sfx.count(&"hurt") == 0 and Sfx.count(&"slash") == 1,
		"dead %s; stomp %d, hurt %d" % [goblin_b.dead, Sfx.count(&"stomp"), Sfx.count(&"hurt")])

	# The cut reaches only in front of him, and only so far.
	_teleport(Vector2(goblin_c.global_position.x + 70.0, ground_y)) # the goblin behind him
	await _frames(2)
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
	var behind_alive := not goblin_c.dead
	_teleport(Vector2(goblin_c.global_position.x - 150.0, ground_y)) # in front, out of reach
	await _frames(2)
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
	_check("a cut misses a goblin behind him, and one 150 px ahead", behind_alive and not goblin_c.dead)
	_teleport(Vector2(goblin_c.global_position.x + 70.0, ground_y))
	await _frames(2)
	await _tap(&"move_left") # a tap turns him on the spot
	await _frames(2)
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
	_check("turned around, the cut reaches the goblin that was behind him", _rudy.facing == -1 and goblin_c.dead,
		"facing %d, dead %s" % [_rudy.facing, goblin_c.dead])
	goblin_b.speed = 100.0
	goblin_c.speed = 100.0

	# A hit while he carries the gear: it flies off instead of a heart.
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool:
		return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and _rudy.is_on_floor() and not _rudy.is_invulnerable(), 120)
	var hearts_before := _rudy.hearts
	_reset_counts()
	_teleport(Vector2(spikes.global_position.x - 220.0, ground_y))
	await _frames(2)
	Input.action_press(&"move_right")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.NONE, 120)
	Input.action_release(&"move_right")
	var flying := 0
	for child in _main.get_children():
		if child is FlyingGear:
			flying += 1
	_check("a hit while he carries the gear knocks it away instead of a heart, with one hurt sound",
		_rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.NONE and _rudy.hearts == hearts_before and Sfx.count(&"hurt") == 1
		and _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.HURT,
		"hearts %d -> %d, hurt sounds %d" % [hearts_before, _rudy.hearts, Sfx.count(&"hurt")])
	_check("the sword and shield fly off", flying == 1, "%d flying" % flying)
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY, 60)
	await _frames(40)
	flying = 0
	for child in _main.get_children():
		if child is FlyingGear:
			flying += 1
	_check("they fade and are gone; he is back in the default form; the pickup stays away",
		flying == 0 and not String(_rudy.pose).begins_with("CHAR-SWORD-") and not pickup.visible,
		"%d flying, pose %s" % [flying, _rudy.pose])

	# Without the gear, the next hit costs a heart.
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_invulnerable(), 120)
	_teleport(Vector2(spikes.global_position.x, ground_y))
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.hearts < hearts_before, 30)
	_check("without the gear, the next hit costs a heart", _rudy.hearts == hearts_before - 1 and Sfx.count(&"hurt") == 2)

	# A death brings the pickup back, and he gets back up without gear.
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and _rudy.is_on_floor(), 120)
	_teleport(Vector2(4400.0, 700.0)) # a fall over the first cliff, past the waystone
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _main.state == Main.State.DYING, 120)
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _main.state == Main.State.PLAYING, 300)
	_check("after a death the pickup is back where it was", pickup.visible and not pickup.taken)
	_reset_counts()
	_teleport(Vector2(pickup.global_position.x - 200.0, ground_y))
	await _frames(2)
	await _hold_until(&"move_right", func() -> bool: return _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.SWORD, 120)
	var had_sword := _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.SWORD and Sfx.count(&"pickup") == 1
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.is_on_floor(), 60)
	_teleport(Vector2(4400.0, 700.0)) # his last heart: the level starts over
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _main.state == Main.State.DYING, 120)
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _main.state == Main.State.PLAYING, 300)
	_check("he gets back up without gear, even when he fell with it, and the pickup is back",
		had_sword and _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.NONE and pickup.visible and _rudy.pose == &"CHAR-IDLE",
		"had the sword %s; gear %s; pose %s" % [had_sword, Rudy.Gear.keys()[_rudy.gear], _rudy.pose])

	var not_taken: PackedStringArray = []

		_frame_mismatches.is_empty() and not_taken.is_empty(),
		"; ".join(_frame_mismatches) + ("" if not_taken.is_empty() else " not taken: " + ", ".join(not_taken)))

2	extends Area2D
3	## The sword-and-shield pickup (PROP-SWORDSHIELD). Rudy's first touch gives him
4	## the sword form, with one pickup sound. It then stops monitoring and hides; it
5	## is never freed, because after a death the level calls reset() and it is back
6	## where it was. Its art (PROP-SWORDSHIELD) is the sword crossed over the shield
7	## with a warm glow, drawn from props.json's origin at SCALE times the art's
8	## game size (about 100 px across), so it is seen from afar, floating and
9	## bobbing a little; it gets no outline, which would follow the glow. The touch
10	## area grows with it. The origin is on the ground below it.
11	
12	const SCALE := 1.5 ## times the art's game size (its texture is at 2 px per game px)
13	const HEIGHT := 76.0 ## px from the ground to its centre
14	const BOB := 6.0 ## px up and down
15	const BOB_PERIOD := 1.6 ## s
16	
17	var taken := false
18	
19	var _clock := 0.0
20	
21	@onready var _art: Sprite2D = $Art
22	
23	
24	func _ready() -> void:
25		body_entered.connect(_on_body_entered)
26	
27	
28	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
29		_clock += delta
30		_art.position.y = -HEIGHT + sin(_clock * TAU / BOB_PERIOD) * BOB
31	
32	
33	## Back where it was, for Rudy to take again.
34	func reset() -> void:
35		taken = false
36		visible = true
37		set_deferred("monitoring", true)
38	
39	
40	func _on_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
41		if taken or not body is Rudy:
42			return
43		var rudy := body as Rudy
44		if not rudy.can_be_touched() or rudy.gear != Rudy.Gear.NONE:
45			return
46		taken = true
47		set_deferred("monitoring", false)
48		visible = false
49		rudy.equip_sword()
50		Sfx.play(&"pickup")
51

## where it was. Its art (PROP-SWORDSHIELD) is the sword crossed over the shield

## game size (about 100 px across), so it is seen from afar, floating and
## bobbing a little; it gets no outline, which would follow the glow. The touch
## area grows with it. The origin is on the ground below it.

const SCALE := 1.5 ## times the art's game size (its texture is at 2 px per game px)
const HEIGHT := 76.0 ## px from the ground to its centre
const BOB := 6.0 ## px up and down
const BOB_PERIOD := 1.6 ## s

var taken := false

var _clock := 0.0

@onready var _art: Sprite2D = $Art


func _ready() -> void:
	body_entered.connect(_on_body_entered)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_clock += delta
	_art.position.y = -HEIGHT + sin(_clock * TAU / BOB_PERIOD) * BOB


## Back where it was, for Rudy to take again.
func reset() -> void:
	taken = false
	visible = true
	set_deferred("monitoring", true)


func _on_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if taken or not body is Rudy:
		return
	var rudy := body as Rudy
	if not rudy.can_be_touched() or rudy.gear != Rudy.Gear.NONE:
		return
	taken = true
	set_deferred("monitoring", false)
	visible = false
	rudy.equip_sword()
	Sfx.play(&"pickup")
