class_name Goblin
extends Area2D
## A patrolling goblin (ENEMY-GOBLIN). It walks back and forth between where it
## starts and `patrol_distance` px to its right. Landing on it from above
## defeats it, with one stomp sound, and bounces Rudy up; touching it any other
## way costs him a heart. After Rudy dies the level calls reset(), and the
## goblin is back where it started, even if it was defeated.
## It asks the physics space each tick whether its box touches Rudy, instead of
## reading the area's overlap list, which reports a contact two ticks late: by
## then a fast fall has sunk his soles too deep to tell a stomp from a side hit.
## Its art (ENEMY-GOBLIN) is two walk frames and a squashed frame, generated
## facing right and mirrored when it walks left, drawn at half scale from
## props.json's origin (its feet) with the outer outline. The box that hurts
## and that Rudy stomps is 40 x 118 px: its body up to the top of its head, not
## its ears, its nose, its swinging arms or the wisps of its hair.
## The origin is at its feet.

const WALK_A := preload("res://content/goblin/frames/ENEMY-GOBLIN-WALK-A.png")
const WALK_B := preload("res://content/goblin/frames/ENEMY-GOBLIN-WALK-B.png")
const SQUASH := preload("res://content/goblin/frames/ENEMY-GOBLIN-SQUASH.png")
const HEIGHT := 118.0 ## the box's height: the top of its head
const WIDTH := 40.0 ## the box's width: its body
const STOMP_MARGIN := 14.0 ## px: Rudy's soles must have been at most this far below its top before his last move
const WALK_FRAME_TIME := 0.18
const SQUASH_TIME := 0.4 ## s the squashed frame shows before it disappears

@export var patrol_distance := 400.0 ## px to the right of where it starts
@export var speed := 100.0 ## px/s

var dead := false
var facing := 1

var _start_x := 0.0
var _walk_clock := 0.0
var _squash_left := 0.0
var _query := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters2D.new()

@onready var _box: CollisionShape2D = $Shape
@onready var _art: Sprite2D = $Art


func _ready() -> void:
	_start_x = position.x
	_query.shape = _box.shape
	_query.collision_mask = 2 # the Player layer
	_query.collide_with_areas = false


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if dead:
		if _squash_left > 0.0:
			_squash_left -= delta
			if _squash_left <= 0.0:
				visible = false
		return
	_patrol(delta)
	_query.transform = _box.global_transform
	for contact in get_world_2d().direct_space_state.intersect_shape(_query, 4):
		if contact.collider is Rudy:
			_touch(contact.collider as Rudy, delta)


## Defeats it once. It stops touching anything before the sound plays, so a
## defeated goblin ignores every later hit.
func defeat(cause: StringName) -> void:
	if dead:
		return
	dead = true
	set_deferred("monitorable", false)
	_squash_left = SQUASH_TIME
	_show_frame()
	if cause == &"stomp":
		Sfx.play(&"stomp")


## Back where it started, alive, walking right.
func reset() -> void:
	dead = false
	position.x = _start_x
	facing = 1
	_walk_clock = 0.0
	_squash_left = 0.0
	visible = true
	set_deferred("monitorable", true)
	_show_frame()


func _patrol(delta: float) -> void:
	position.x += facing * speed * delta
	# Turn at each end. It only turns, so a goblin placed outside its patrol
	# walks back into it instead of jumping there.
	if position.x >= _start_x + patrol_distance:
		facing = -1
	elif position.x <= _start_x:
		facing = 1
	_walk_clock += delta
	_show_frame()


func _touch(rudy: Rudy, delta: float) -> void:
	if not rudy.can_be_touched():
		return
	var top := global_position.y - HEIGHT
	var soles_before := rudy.global_position.y - rudy.velocity.y * delta
	if rudy.velocity.y > 0.0 and soles_before <= top + STOMP_MARGIN:
		defeat(&"stomp")
		rudy.bounce()
	else:
		rudy.take_hit(global_position)


func _walk_frame() -> int:
	return int(_walk_clock / WALK_FRAME_TIME) % 2


## The frame for its state, facing the way it walks.
func _show_frame() -> void:
	_art.texture = SQUASH if dead else (WALK_B if _walk_frame() == 1 else WALK_A)
	_art.flip_h = facing < 0

1	extends Node
2	## Headless state checks for Effect A, the sword-swing sparks (CHANGE-BRIEF.md,
3	## section 2, rules A1–A5). Run from this folder:
4	##   scripts/run-test.sh test_slash_sparks_state.tscn 60
5	## It plays Main through the real game loop: every cut comes from the slash
6	## action, the sword from walking into the pickup, the pause from the pause
7	## action. It never calls the driver. The only game state it writes is Rudy's
8	## place, as checks.gd's _teleport does, to put him next to the pickup, a
9	## goblin or open ground.
10	## A recorder reads, each physics tick, the sword hitbox's disabled flag and
11	## every burst the driver adds to Effects/SlashBursts. This node runs before
12	## Main's nodes in each tick, so what it reads is the state at the end of the
13	## tick before: an edge it sees on tick N happened on tick N - 1.
14	## Headless, the dummy renderer draws nothing and runs no particle process, so
15	## these checks read node state only (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
16	## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.
17	
18	const MAIN := preload("res://app/main.tscn")
19	
20	
21	## One burst as the recorder saw it.
22	class Burst:
23		var node: Node2D
24		var born := -1 ## the tick the driver added it
25		var exited := -1 ## the tick it left the tree
26		var in_container := false ## its parent is Effects/SlashBursts, and no Rudy or goblin is its ancestor
27		var sampled := false
28		# Read on the tick after its birth, before anything else moves:
29		var pos: Vector2
30		var shape_pos: Vector2
31		var x_axis_x := 0.0 ## global_transform.x.x: its mirror sign
32		var facing := 0
33		var others: Array[Dictionary] = [] ## every other live burst then: node, pos, emitting
34	
35	
36	var _failures := 0
37	var _main: Main
38	var _rudy: Rudy
39	var _box: CollisionShape2D
40	var _slash_bursts: Node2D
41	var _tick := 0
42	var _was_disabled := true
43	var _edges: Array[int] = [] ## ticks on which the hitbox went from disabled to live
44	var _bursts: Array[Burst] = []
45	var _max_alive := 0
46	
47	
48	func _ready() -> void:
49		await _run_load()
50		await _run_play()
51		print("all checks passed" if _failures == 0 else "%d check(s) FAILED" % _failures)
52		get_tree().quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)
53	
54	
55	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
56		if not is_instance_valid(_rudy):
57			return
58		_tick += 1
59		var disabled := _box.disabled
60		if _was_disabled and not disabled:
61			_edges.append(_tick - 1)
62		_was_disabled = disabled
63		for b in _bursts:
64			if not b.sampled and is_instance_valid(b.node) and b.node.is_inside_tree():
65				b.sampled = true
66				b.pos = b.node.global_position
67				b.shape_pos = _box.global_position
68				b.x_axis_x = b.node.global_transform.x.x
69				b.facing = _rudy.facing
70				for other in _bursts:
71					if other != b and is_instance_valid(other.node) and other.node.is_inside_tree():
72						b.others.append({
73							"node": other.node,
74							"pos": other.node.global_position,
75							"emitting": (other.node.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).emitting,
76						})
77		_max_alive = maxi(_max_alive, _alive())
78	
79	
80	## A fresh level; without `with_title` it skips the title and starts in play.
81	func _start_level(with_title := false) -> void:
82		Main.title_shown = not with_title
83		_main = MAIN.instantiate()
84		add_child(_main)
85		_rudy = _main.get_node("Rudy")
86		_box = _rudy.get_node("SwordHitbox/Shape")
87		_slash_bursts = _main.get_node("Effects/SlashBursts")
88		_slash_bursts.child_entered_tree.connect(_on_burst_entered)
89		_was_disabled = _box.disabled
90	
91	
92	func _on_burst_entered(node: Node) -> void:
93		var b := Burst.new()
94		b.node = node
95		b.born = _tick
96		var ancestor_is_game := _rudy.is_ancestor_of(node)
97		for goblin in _main.get_node("Level1/Enemies").get_children():
98			ancestor_is_game = ancestor_is_game or goblin.is_ancestor_of(node)
99		b.in_container = node.get_parent() == _slash_bursts and not ancestor_is_game
100		node.tree_exited.connect(func() -> void: b.exited = _tick)
101		_bursts.append(b)
102	
103	
104	## S1, S2: nothing fires on load or on the title.
105	func _run_load() -> void:
106		_start_level(true)
107		await _frames(60)
108		await _tap(&"slash")
109		await _frames(30)
110		_check("S1 on load and on the title, with slash pressed there: no burst",
111			_bursts.is_empty() and _main.state == Main.State.TITLE,
112			"bursts %d, state %s" % [_bursts.size(), Main.State.keys()[_main.state]])
113		_main.queue_free()
114		await _frames(1)
115	
116		_start_level()
117		await _frames(60)
118		_check("S2 on load with the title skipped, after 60 ticks: no burst", _bursts.is_empty(),
119			"bursts %d" % _bursts.size())
120	
121	
122	func _run_play() -> void:
123		var level: Node2D = _main.get_node("Level1")
124		var pickup: SwordPickup = level.get_node("SwordPickup")
125		var goblin_a: Goblin = level.get_node("Enemies/GoblinA")
126		var goblin_b: Goblin = level.get_node("Enemies/GoblinB")
127		var ground_y := (level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position.y
128	
129		# S3: slash without the sword.
130		var n := _bursts.size()
131		var e := _edges.size()
132		await _tap(&"slash")
133		await _frames(30)
134		_check("S3 slash without the sword: no burst, no live edge",
135			_bursts.size() == n and _edges.size() == e and _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.NONE,
136			"bursts %d, edges %d" % [_bursts.size() - n, _edges.size() - e])
137	
138		# The sword, by walking into the pickup.
139		_teleport(Vector2(pickup.global_position.x - 200.0, ground_y))
140		await _frames(2)
141		await _hold_until(&"move_right", func() -> bool: return _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.SWORD, 120)
142		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.is_on_floor() and _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 60)
143	
144		# S4, S5: one cut facing right.
145		n = _bursts.size()
146		e = _edges.size()
147		await _tap(&"slash")
148		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
149		await _frames(2)
150		var new_bursts := _bursts.slice(n)
151		var new_edges := _edges.slice(e)
152		_check("S4 one cut: exactly one burst, born on the tick the hitbox went live",
153			new_bursts.size() == 1 and new_edges.size() == 1 and new_bursts[0].born == new_edges[0],
154			"bursts born on %s, edges on %s" % [_born_ticks(new_bursts), new_edges])
155		if new_bursts.size() == 1:
156			var b: Burst = new_bursts[0]
157			_check("S5 facing right: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and not mirrored",
158				b.sampled and b.pos.distance_to(b.shape_pos) <= 1.0 and b.x_axis_x > 0.0 and b.facing == 1,
159				"burst %s, hitbox %s, x.x %.2f, facing %d" % [b.pos, b.shape_pos, b.x_axis_x, b.facing])
160		else:
161			_check("S5 facing right: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and not mirrored", false, "no single burst")
162	
163		# S6: turned on the spot, one cut facing left.
164		await _tap(&"move_left")
165		await _frames(2)
166		n = _bursts.size()
167		await _tap(&"slash")
168		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
169		await _frames(2)
170		new_bursts = _bursts.slice(n)
171		if new_bursts.size() == 1:
172			var b: Burst = new_bursts[0]
173			_check("S6 facing left: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and mirrored",
174				b.sampled and b.pos.distance_to(b.shape_pos) <= 1.0 and b.x_axis_x < 0.0 and b.facing == -1,
175				"burst %s, hitbox %s, x.x %.2f, facing %d" % [b.pos, b.shape_pos, b.x_axis_x, b.facing])
176		else:
177			_check("S6 facing left: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and mirrored", false,
178				"%d bursts" % new_bursts.size())
179		await _frames(40)
180	
181		# S7, S8: a second cut right after the first swing ends, inside the first burst's life.
182		n = _bursts.size()
183		e = _edges.size()
184		await _tap(&"slash")
185		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
186		await _tap(&"slash")
187		await _frames(45)
188		new_bursts = _bursts.slice(n)
189		new_edges = _edges.slice(e)
190		if new_bursts.size() == 2 and new_edges.size() == 2:
191			var first: Burst = new_bursts[0]
192			var second: Burst = new_bursts[1]
193			var seen: Dictionary = {}
194			for other in second.others:
195				if other.node == first.node:
196					seen = other
197			_check("S7 two cuts %d ticks apart: two bursts alive at the second cut; the first is the same node, not moved, still emitting"
198					% (new_edges[1] - new_edges[0]),
199				second.born == new_edges[1] and second.others.size() == 1 and not seen.is_empty()
200				and (seen.pos as Vector2).distance_to(first.pos) <= 0.01 and seen.emitting,
201				"alive with the second %d, first seen %s, first at %s then %s, emitting %s"
202				% [second.others.size() + 1, not seen.is_empty(), first.pos, seen.get("pos"), seen.get("emitting")])
203			_check("S8 the first burst leaves the tree 25–30 ticks after its birth: not restarted, not cut short",
204				first.exited - first.born >= 25 and first.exited - first.born <= 30,
205				"born %d, left %d: %d ticks" % [first.born, first.exited, first.exited - first.born])
206		else:
207			_check("S7 two cuts: two bursts alive at the second cut", false,
208				"bursts born on %s, edges on %s" % [_born_ticks(new_bursts), new_edges])
209			var life: int = (new_bursts[0].exited - new_bursts[0].born) if not new_bursts.is_empty() else -1
210			_check("S8 the first burst leaves the tree 25–30 ticks after its birth: not restarted, not cut short",
211				life >= 25 and life <= 30, "%d ticks" % life)
212	
213		# S9: mashing slash for 2 s.
214		n = _bursts.size()
215		e = _edges.size()
216		_max_alive = 0
217		var swings := 0
218		var was_slashing := false
219		for i in 120:
220			if i % 2 == 0:
221				Input.action_press(&"slash")
222			else:
223				Input.action_release(&"slash")
224			await _frames(1)
225			if _rudy.is_slashing() and not was_slashing:
226				swings += 1
227			was_slashing = _rudy.is_slashing()
228		Input.action_release(&"slash")
229		await _frames(45)
230		_check("S9 mashing slash: one burst per live edge per swing, and never more than 2 alive",
231			swings >= 3 and _bursts.size() - n == swings and _edges.size() - e == swings and _max_alive <= 2,
232			"%d swings, %d edges, %d bursts, at most %d alive" % [swings, _edges.size() - e, _bursts.size() - n, _max_alive])
233	
234		# S10: where every burst so far lives.
235		var outside := _bursts.filter(func(b: Burst) -> bool: return not b.in_container)
236		_check("S10 every burst's parent is Effects/SlashBursts, and no Rudy or goblin is its ancestor",
237			not _bursts.is_empty() and outside.is_empty(), "%d bursts, %d outside" % [_bursts.size(), outside.size()])
238	
239		# S11: a cut that defeats a goblin.
240		await _tap(&"move_right")
241		await _frames(2)
242		_teleport(Vector2(goblin_b.global_position.x - 70.0, ground_y))
243		await _frames(2)
244		n = _bursts.size()
245		await _tap(&"slash")
246		await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _bursts.size() > n, 30)
247		var visible_ticks := 0
248		var hidden_ticks := 0

extends Node
## Headless state checks for Effect A, the sword-swing sparks (CHANGE-BRIEF.md,
## section 2, rules A1–A5). Run from this folder:
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_slash_sparks_state.tscn 60
## It plays Main through the real game loop: every cut comes from the slash
## action, the sword from walking into the pickup, the pause from the pause
## action. It never calls the driver. The only game state it writes is Rudy's
## place, as checks.gd's _teleport does, to put him next to the pickup, a
## goblin or open ground.
## A recorder reads, each physics tick, the sword hitbox's disabled flag and
## every burst the driver adds to Effects/SlashBursts. This node runs before
## Main's nodes in each tick, so what it reads is the state at the end of the
## tick before: an edge it sees on tick N happened on tick N - 1.
## Headless, the dummy renderer draws nothing and runs no particle process, so
## these checks read node state only (CLAUDE.md, Headless facts).
## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.

const MAIN := preload("res://app/main.tscn")


## One burst as the recorder saw it.
class Burst:
	var node: Node2D
	var born := -1 ## the tick the driver added it
	var exited := -1 ## the tick it left the tree
	var in_container := false ## its parent is Effects/SlashBursts, and no Rudy or goblin is its ancestor
	var sampled := false
	# Read on the tick after its birth, before anything else moves:
	var pos: Vector2
	var shape_pos: Vector2
	var x_axis_x := 0.0 ## global_transform.x.x: its mirror sign
	var facing := 0
	var others: Array[Dictionary] = [] ## every other live burst then: node, pos, emitting


var _failures := 0
var _main: Main
var _rudy: Rudy
var _box: CollisionShape2D
var _slash_bursts: Node2D
var _tick := 0
var _was_disabled := true
var _edges: Array[int] = [] ## ticks on which the hitbox went from disabled to live
var _bursts: Array[Burst] = []
var _max_alive := 0


func _ready() -> void:
	await _run_load()
	await _run_play()
	print("all checks passed" if _failures == 0 else "%d check(s) FAILED" % _failures)
	get_tree().quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(_rudy):
		return
	_tick += 1
	var disabled := _box.disabled
	if _was_disabled and not disabled:
		_edges.append(_tick - 1)
	_was_disabled = disabled
	for b in _bursts:
		if not b.sampled and is_instance_valid(b.node) and b.node.is_inside_tree():
			b.sampled = true
			b.pos = b.node.global_position
			b.shape_pos = _box.global_position
			b.x_axis_x = b.node.global_transform.x.x
			b.facing = _rudy.facing
			for other in _bursts:
				if other != b and is_instance_valid(other.node) and other.node.is_inside_tree():
					b.others.append({
						"node": other.node,
						"pos": other.node.global_position,
						"emitting": (other.node.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).emitting,
					})
	_max_alive = maxi(_max_alive, _alive())


## A fresh level; without `with_title` it skips the title and starts in play.
func _start_level(with_title := false) -> void:
	Main.title_shown = not with_title
	_main = MAIN.instantiate()
	add_child(_main)
	_rudy = _main.get_node("Rudy")
	_box = _rudy.get_node("SwordHitbox/Shape")
	_slash_bursts = _main.get_node("Effects/SlashBursts")
	_slash_bursts.child_entered_tree.connect(_on_burst_entered)
	_was_disabled = _box.disabled


func _on_burst_entered(node: Node) -> void:
	var b := Burst.new()
	b.node = node
	b.born = _tick
	var ancestor_is_game := _rudy.is_ancestor_of(node)
	for goblin in _main.get_node("Level1/Enemies").get_children():
		ancestor_is_game = ancestor_is_game or goblin.is_ancestor_of(node)
	b.in_container = node.get_parent() == _slash_bursts and not ancestor_is_game
	node.tree_exited.connect(func() -> void: b.exited = _tick)
	_bursts.append(b)


## S1, S2: nothing fires on load or on the title.
func _run_load() -> void:
	_start_level(true)
	await _frames(60)
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _frames(30)
	_check("S1 on load and on the title, with slash pressed there: no burst",
		_bursts.is_empty() and _main.state == Main.State.TITLE,
		"bursts %d, state %s" % [_bursts.size(), Main.State.keys()[_main.state]])
	_main.queue_free()
	await _frames(1)

	_start_level()
	await _frames(60)
	_check("S2 on load with the title skipped, after 60 ticks: no burst", _bursts.is_empty(),
		"bursts %d" % _bursts.size())


func _run_play() -> void:
	var level: Node2D = _main.get_node("Level1")
	var pickup: SwordPickup = level.get_node("SwordPickup")
	var goblin_a: Goblin = level.get_node("Enemies/GoblinA")
	var goblin_b: Goblin = level.get_node("Enemies/GoblinB")
	var ground_y := (level.get_node("StartPoint") as Marker2D).global_position.y

	# S3: slash without the sword.
	var n := _bursts.size()
	var e := _edges.size()
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _frames(30)
	_check("S3 slash without the sword: no burst, no live edge",
		_bursts.size() == n and _edges.size() == e and _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.NONE,
		"bursts %d, edges %d" % [_bursts.size() - n, _edges.size() - e])

	# The sword, by walking into the pickup.
	_teleport(Vector2(pickup.global_position.x - 200.0, ground_y))
	await _frames(2)
	await _hold_until(&"move_right", func() -> bool: return _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.SWORD, 120)
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.is_on_floor() and _rudy.velocity.x == 0.0, 60)

	# S4, S5: one cut facing right.
	n = _bursts.size()
	e = _edges.size()
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
	await _frames(2)
	var new_bursts := _bursts.slice(n)
	var new_edges := _edges.slice(e)
	_check("S4 one cut: exactly one burst, born on the tick the hitbox went live",
		new_bursts.size() == 1 and new_edges.size() == 1 and new_bursts[0].born == new_edges[0],
		"bursts born on %s, edges on %s" % [_born_ticks(new_bursts), new_edges])
	if new_bursts.size() == 1:
		var b: Burst = new_bursts[0]
		_check("S5 facing right: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and not mirrored",
			b.sampled and b.pos.distance_to(b.shape_pos) <= 1.0 and b.x_axis_x > 0.0 and b.facing == 1,
			"burst %s, hitbox %s, x.x %.2f, facing %d" % [b.pos, b.shape_pos, b.x_axis_x, b.facing])
	else:
		_check("S5 facing right: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and not mirrored", false, "no single burst")

	# S6: turned on the spot, one cut facing left.
	await _tap(&"move_left")
	await _frames(2)
	n = _bursts.size()
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
	await _frames(2)
	new_bursts = _bursts.slice(n)
	if new_bursts.size() == 1:
		var b: Burst = new_bursts[0]
		_check("S6 facing left: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and mirrored",
			b.sampled and b.pos.distance_to(b.shape_pos) <= 1.0 and b.x_axis_x < 0.0 and b.facing == -1,
			"burst %s, hitbox %s, x.x %.2f, facing %d" % [b.pos, b.shape_pos, b.x_axis_x, b.facing])
	else:
		_check("S6 facing left: the burst is on the hitbox within 1 px, and mirrored", false,
			"%d bursts" % new_bursts.size())
	await _frames(40)

	# S7, S8: a second cut right after the first swing ends, inside the first burst's life.
	n = _bursts.size()
	e = _edges.size()
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return not _rudy.is_slashing(), 60)
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _frames(45)
	new_bursts = _bursts.slice(n)
	new_edges = _edges.slice(e)
	if new_bursts.size() == 2 and new_edges.size() == 2:
		var first: Burst = new_bursts[0]
		var second: Burst = new_bursts[1]
		var seen: Dictionary = {}
		for other in second.others:
			if other.node == first.node:
				seen = other
		_check("S7 two cuts %d ticks apart: two bursts alive at the second cut; the first is the same node, not moved, still emitting"
				% (new_edges[1] - new_edges[0]),
			second.born == new_edges[1] and second.others.size() == 1 and not seen.is_empty()
			and (seen.pos as Vector2).distance_to(first.pos) <= 0.01 and seen.emitting,
			"alive with the second %d, first seen %s, first at %s then %s, emitting %s"
			% [second.others.size() + 1, not seen.is_empty(), first.pos, seen.get("pos"), seen.get("emitting")])
		_check("S8 the first burst leaves the tree 25–30 ticks after its birth: not restarted, not cut short",
			first.exited - first.born >= 25 and first.exited - first.born <= 30,
			"born %d, left %d: %d ticks" % [first.born, first.exited, first.exited - first.born])
	else:
		_check("S7 two cuts: two bursts alive at the second cut", false,
			"bursts born on %s, edges on %s" % [_born_ticks(new_bursts), new_edges])
		var life: int = (new_bursts[0].exited - new_bursts[0].born) if not new_bursts.is_empty() else -1
		_check("S8 the first burst leaves the tree 25–30 ticks after its birth: not restarted, not cut short",
			life >= 25 and life <= 30, "%d ticks" % life)

	# S9: mashing slash for 2 s.
	n = _bursts.size()
	e = _edges.size()
	_max_alive = 0
	var swings := 0
	var was_slashing := false
	for i in 120:
		if i % 2 == 0:
			Input.action_press(&"slash")
		else:
			Input.action_release(&"slash")
		await _frames(1)
		if _rudy.is_slashing() and not was_slashing:
			swings += 1
		was_slashing = _rudy.is_slashing()
	Input.action_release(&"slash")
	await _frames(45)
	_check("S9 mashing slash: one burst per live edge per swing, and never more than 2 alive",
		swings >= 3 and _bursts.size() - n == swings and _edges.size() - e == swings and _max_alive <= 2,
		"%d swings, %d edges, %d bursts, at most %d alive" % [swings, _edges.size() - e, _bursts.size() - n, _max_alive])

	# S10: where every burst so far lives.
	var outside := _bursts.filter(func(b: Burst) -> bool: return not b.in_container)
	_check("S10 every burst's parent is Effects/SlashBursts, and no Rudy or goblin is its ancestor",
		not _bursts.is_empty() and outside.is_empty(), "%d bursts, %d outside" % [_bursts.size(), outside.size()])

	# S11: a cut that defeats a goblin.
	await _tap(&"move_right")
	await _frames(2)
	_teleport(Vector2(goblin_b.global_position.x - 70.0, ground_y))
	await _frames(2)
	n = _bursts.size()
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _bursts.size() > n, 30)
	var visible_ticks := 0
	var hidden_ticks := 0
	var goblin_gone_while_visible := false
	if _bursts.size() > n:
		var b: Burst = _bursts[n]
		for i in 30:
			if is_instance_valid(b.node) and b.node.is_inside_tree():
				if b.node.is_visible_in_tree():
					visible_ticks += 1
					goblin_gone_while_visible = goblin_gone_while_visible or not goblin_b.visible
				else:
					hidden_ticks += 1
			await _frames(1)
	_check("S11 a cut defeats a goblin: the goblin hides while the burst is still visible, and the burst is visible every tick of its life",
		goblin_b.dead and goblin_gone_while_visible and hidden_ticks == 0 and visible_ticks >= 25,
		"goblin dead %s, hidden while the burst showed %s; burst visible %d ticks, hidden %d"
		% [goblin_b.dead, goblin_gone_while_visible, visible_ticks, hidden_ticks])

	# S12: a stomp with the sword.
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool:
		return _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and _rudy.is_on_floor() and not _rudy.is_invulnerable(), 120)
	n = _bursts.size()
	e = _edges.size()
	_teleport(Vector2(goblin_a.global_position.x, ground_y - Goblin.HEIGHT - 60.0))
	_rudy.velocity = Vector2(0, 200)
	await _frames(1)
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return goblin_a.dead or _rudy.is_on_floor(), 60)
	await _frames(30)
	_check("S12 a stomp with the sword: no burst, no live edge",
		goblin_a.dead and _rudy.gear == Rudy.Gear.SWORD and _bursts.size() == n and _edges.size() == e,
		"goblin dead %s, gear %s, bursts %d, edges %d"
		% [goblin_a.dead, Rudy.Gear.keys()[_rudy.gear], _bursts.size() - n, _edges.size() - e])

	# S13: slash while paused.
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _rudy.is_on_floor(), 60)
	await _frames(10)
	n = _bursts.size()
	await _tap(&"pause")
	var paused := _main.is_paused()
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _frames(30)
	var while_paused := _bursts.size() - n
	await _tap(&"pause")
	var resumed := not _main.is_paused()
	await _frames(10)
	_check("S13 slash while paused: no burst then, and none in the 10 ticks after resuming",
		paused and resumed and while_paused == 0 and _bursts.size() == n,
		"paused %s, resumed %s; bursts while paused %d, after %d" % [paused, resumed, while_paused, _bursts.size() - n - while_paused])

	# S14: a burst alive when the tree pauses.
	n = _bursts.size()
	await _tap(&"slash")
	await _wait_until(func() -> bool: return _bursts.size() > n, 30)
	await _tap(&"pause")
	await _frames(30)
	var ok := false
	var detail := "no burst"
	if _bursts.size() > n:
		var b: Burst = _bursts[n]
		var alive := is_instance_valid(b.node) and b.node.is_inside_tree()
		var sparks: GPUParticles2D = b.node.get_node("Sparks") if alive else null
		var shown := alive and b.node.is_visible_in_tree()
		var emitting := alive and sparks.emitting
		var processing := alive and sparks.can_process()
		await _tap(&"pause")
		var runs_again := alive and is_instance_valid(sparks) and sparks.can_process()
		ok = not _main.is_paused() and shown and emitting and not processing and runs_again
		detail = "while paused: in the tree %s, visible %s, emitting %s, processing %s; after resuming: processing %s" % [
			alive, shown, emitting, processing, runs_again]
	_check("S14 a burst alive at a pause stays in the tree and visible, still emitting, and stops processing until resumed",
		ok, detail)


func _alive() -> int:
	var count := 0
	for child in _slash_bursts.get_children():
		if not child.is_queued_for_deletion():
			count += 1
	return count


func _born_ticks(bursts: Array) -> Array[int]:
	var ticks: Array[int] = []
	for b: Burst in bursts:
		ticks.append(b.born)
	return ticks


func _check(what: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	print("%s  %s%s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, "" if detail.is_empty() else "  (%s)" % detail])
	if not ok:
		_failures += 1


func _frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await get_tree().physics_frame


## Waits until `condition` is true, for at most `max_ticks`; returns the ticks waited.
func _wait_until(condition: Callable, max_ticks: int) -> int:
	for t in max_ticks:
		if condition.call():
			return t
		await get_tree().physics_frame
	return max_ticks


func _hold_until(action: StringName, condition: Callable, max_ticks: int) -> void:
	Input.action_press(action)
	await _wait_until(condition, max_ticks)
	Input.action_release(action)


func _tap(action: StringName) -> void:
	Input.action_press(action)
	await _frames(2)
	Input.action_release(action)


func _teleport(spot: Vector2) -> void:
	_rudy.global_position = spot
	_rudy.velocity = Vector2.ZERO

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
#
# The course's Assignment 6 wrapper as assignment-6/ adapted it, carried into
# Assignment 7. The four changes from assignment-6 stay:
#   - The project is game/ (the 2D game, from Assignment 2), so it runs
#     --path game; the course's version runs --path godot.
#   - A .tscn test runs as the scene, as the game's checks.tscn always has (its
#     script extends Node, so --script cannot run it); a .gd test still runs
#     with --script. The log is named after the file without its extension.
#   - Godot is $GODOT if set, else godot on PATH, else the macOS app's binary.
#   - It runs from this folder wherever it is called from, so the project path
#     resolves and the logs land in its logs/.
# New in Assignment 7: a resource that fails to load fails the run. Godot 4.7.2
# loads a scene whose texture or sub-scene is missing, instances it and exits
# 0, saying so only in the log (evidence/load-error-probe/). So besides SHADER
# ERROR and SCRIPT ERROR, the run fails on these lines from that probe:
#   Cannot open file          a file that does not exist
#   Failed loading resource   any load that returned null
#   Resource file not found   a missing ext_resource or typed load
#   Parse Error               a broken .tres/.tscn, or an ext_resource that
#                             names a missing file (the scene still loads)
#   Error loading resource    ResourceLoader.load() of a missing file
#   Failed to load script     a script that does not compile
#   couldn't resolve track    an animation track naming a node that does not
#                             exist (a WARNING; a missing property prints
#                             nothing, so the read-back test must check that)
# When one of these fails the run, the wrapper prints the lines it matched.
# Unchanged from the course: the realtime mode (no --fixed-fps, for tests that
# wait on audio), the optional timeout (120 s by default; status 124 means the
# test hung), the log name logs/<test>_<fps>fps.log or logs/<test>_realtime.log,
# and that exit code 0 does not mean no errors.
set -o pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
if [ $# -lt 2 ] || [ $# -gt 3 ] || [ ! -f "game/tests/$1" ]; then
	echo "usage: scripts/run-test.sh <test-file in game/tests/> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]" >&2
	exit 2
fi
godot=${GODOT:-$(command -v godot || echo /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot)}
if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
	fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
else
	fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
fi
if [[ $1 == *.tscn ]]; then
	run_args=("res://tests/$1")
else
	run_args=(--script "res://tests/$1")
fi
mkdir -p logs
log="logs/$(basename "${1%.*}")_${tag}.log"
timeout "${3:-120}" "$godot" --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path game "${run_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
status=$?
errors="SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR|Cannot open file|Failed loading resource|Resource file not found|Parse Error|Error loading resource|Failed to load script|couldn't resolve track"
if grep -qE "$errors" "$log"; then
	echo "run-test.sh: FAILED on an error line in $log:" >&2
	grep -nE "$errors" "$log" >&2
	status=1
fi
exit $status

extends Node
## Rudy on a floor with the sword; one slash press sent three ways. Logs every
## physics tick: pose, the swing clock, whether the hitbox is live.
var rudy
var logger
func _key(pressed: bool) -> void:
	var e := InputEventKey.new(); e.physical_keycode = KEY_J; e.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(e)
func _setup() -> void:
	var root := Node2D.new(); add_child(root)
	var floor := StaticBody2D.new(); var cs := CollisionShape2D.new(); var r := RectangleShape2D.new(); r.size = Vector2(20000, 100); cs.shape = r; cs.position = Vector2(0, 50); floor.add_child(cs); root.add_child(floor)
	rudy = (load("res://content/rudy/rudy.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate(); rudy.position = Vector2(0, 0); root.add_child(rudy); rudy.equip_sword()
	logger = load("res://tests/probe/tick_logger.gd").new(); logger.rudy = rudy; logger.process_physics_priority = 100; root.add_child(logger)
func _ready() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()
func _run() -> void:
	_setup()
	for i in 20: await get_tree().process_frame
	var mode: String = OS.get_environment("PROBE_MODE")
	print("MODE ", mode, " fixed_fps ", Engine.max_fps, " ticks/s ", Engine.physics_ticks_per_second)
	logger.lines.clear(); logger.t0 = -1
	if mode == "frame":
		_key(true)
		await get_tree().process_frame
		_key(false)
	elif mode == "physics":
		# shift the press by one physics tick: send it between the two ticks of a frame and flush
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await get_tree().physics_frame
		_key(true); Input.flush_buffered_events()
		await get_tree().process_frame
		_key(false)
	for i in 30: await get_tree().physics_frame
	for l in logger.lines: print(l)
	get_tree().quit(0)

8	|---|---|---|---|
9	| `probe_slash_ticks.tscn` | Rudy from `rudy.tscn` on a floor, with the sword. One press of `J` through `Input.parse_input_event`. A logger after him (`process_physics_priority` 100) prints every physics tick | The press is read on tick 0, which shows `CHAR-SWORD-SLASH`. The hitbox is live on ticks 2–10, 9 ticks. The slash pose shows on ticks 0–16, 17 ticks (0.283 s): on tick 17 the clock reaches `slash_time` and the swing ends on that tick, so he shows `CHAR-SWORD-IDLE` | `logs/slash_ticks_60fps_frame.log:4-21` |
10	| the same, `PROBE_MODE=physics` | Waits for one `process_frame`, then one `physics_frame`, then sends the press and calls `Input.flush_buffered_events()` | At 30 fps (two ticks per frame) the press lands on the **second** tick of a rendered frame (tick 3, frame 21), where a press sent at a frame lands on the first (tick 0, frame 20). This is how a test produces the second tick offset | `logs/slash_ticks_30fps_frame.log:4-7`, `logs/slash_ticks_30fps_physics.log:6-9`; at 60 fps it only moves the press two ticks later (`logs/slash_ticks_60fps_physics.log:5-6`) |
11	| `probe_anim_clock.gd`, `physics` | A host node calls `play()` from its own `_physics_process`, as `rudy.gd` would, on a child `AnimationPlayer` set to `callback_mode_process` physics. A slash-like clip: a discrete `Sprite:frame` key and a continuous `Grip:rotation_degrees` track (−70° at 0, −60° at 2/60 s, 55° at 11/60 s, 10° at 0.3 s) | The default `callback_mode_process` is 1, idle. **From a stopped player**, `play()` on tick 2 shows its first key on tick 3: one tick late. **From a playing player**, `play()` on tick 23 shows its first key on tick 23. After that the clip time is exactly (ticks since `play()`)/60, at 60 fps and at 30 fps alike. `play("slash")` again during the slash (tick 8) does not restart it; `play("idle")` and then `play("slash")` does | `logs/anim_clock_physics_60fps.log:3`, `:7-8`, `:10`, `:13-14`, `:26-28`; `logs/anim_clock_physics_30fps.log:9-13` |
12	| the same, `idle` | The same clip with the default idle callback | At 60 fps the clip trails gameplay by a tick. At 30 fps it advances once per rendered frame, in uneven steps (0, 0.0292, 0.0592 s): a second clock beside the physics ticks | `logs/anim_clock_idle_60fps.log`, `logs/anim_clock_idle_30fps.log:7-13` |
13	| the same, `run` and `continuous` | A run clip: `Sprite:frame` cell 1 at 0, cell 2 at 0.125 s, `length` 0.25, `LOOP_LINEAR`; discrete, then continuous | Discrete: cell 2 from 0.1333 s, cells lasting 8, 8, 7, 8 ticks (0.125 s is 7.5 ticks). Continuous: cell 2 from 0.0667 s and back to cell 1 at 0.2 s, **4 ticks early** each time; the two cells are neighbours, so it shifts the timing rather than sweeping through other cells | `logs/anim_run_discrete_60fps.log:8-31`, `logs/anim_run_continuous_60fps.log:11-20` |
14	| `probe_g3_names.gd` | Loads Godot 3 names from resource text, and runs the assignment's `track_problems()` on a clip with a good track, a missing node and a missing property | `loop = true` in a `.tres` **loads as `loop_mode` 1 (linear)**: 4.7.2 maps it. `playback_speed = 2.0` in a `.tscn` is **dropped**: `speed_scale` stays 1.0. `track_problems()` reports both the missing node and the missing property. `root_node` defaults to `..` | `logs/godot3_names_resource.log:3-7` |
15	| `frame_margins.py` | Reads each of Rudy's 16 game frames' alpha and prints its transparent margins (`python3 -I tests/frame_margins.py game/content/rudy/frames`, from this folder's parent) | Every frame keeps at least 16 texture px on each side; the slash frame has the least on the left and bottom. The outline reaches 8 texture px (`game/systems/art/outline.tres`), so packed edge to edge in a sheet, no cell's outline or mipmap reaches its neighbour | `logs/frame_margins.log` |
16	| `probe_g3_code.gd` | The same names set from code | `set("loop", true)` also sets `loop_mode` 1, though `"loop" in Animation` is false. `set("playback_speed", 2.0)` is dropped. On `AnimatedSprite2D`, `frames` maps to `sprite_frames`, but `playing = true` does not play | `logs/godot3_names_code.log:3-6` |
17	
18	**What this changes in the course's warnings.** The assignment says a clip written with `loop = true` "doesn't loop and may load without complaint." In 4.7.2 it loops: the old name is mapped. The `loop_mode` read-back check still matters, because a clip can carry the wrong `loop_mode` for other reasons, but the Godot 3 name is not one of them here. `playback_speed` is the trap that is real.

1	class_name EffectsDriver
2	extends Node2D
3	## Starts the presentation effects from the game's state (CHANGE-BRIEF.md).
4	## It only reads game state, and it only places, mirrors, starts and frees the
5	## effects: their settings live in their scene files.
6	##
7	## Effect A, the sword-swing sparks: each tick that Rudy's sword hitbox goes
8	## from disabled to live, a new SlashSparks burst starts at the hitbox, facing
9	## his way. Every cut gets its own burst, so a fast second cut leaves the first
10	## one running (rule A3), and each burst frees itself once its sparks finish.
11	## It sits after Rudy in Main, so it sees the edge on the tick _swing() makes it.
12	##
13	## Effect B, the running dust trail: RunDust sits in DustTrail, before Rudy in
14	## Main so it draws behind him, and this driver keeps it at his soles every tick.
15	## It emits while he runs on the ground under control and the emitter is visible
16	## in the tree (rules B1, B2, B4). While the tree is paused this driver does not
17	## run, so emitting keeps its value (B3).
18	
19	const SLASH_SPARKS := preload("res://effects/slash_sparks.tscn")
20	const RUN_DUST_OFFSET := Vector2(0, -4)
21	
22	var _box_was_disabled: bool
23	
24	@onready var _rudy: Rudy = get_node("../Rudy")
25	@onready var _sword_box: CollisionShape2D = _rudy.get_node("SwordHitbox/Shape")
26	@onready var _slash_bursts: Node2D = $SlashBursts
27	@onready var _run_dust: GPUParticles2D = get_node("../DustTrail/RunDust")
28	
29	
30	func _ready() -> void:
31		_box_was_disabled = _sword_box.disabled # so a load never fires a burst
32	
33	
34	func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
35		var disabled := _sword_box.disabled
36		if _box_was_disabled and not disabled:
37			_fire_slash_sparks()
38		_box_was_disabled = disabled
39		_drive_run_dust()
40	
41	
42	func _fire_slash_sparks() -> void:
43		var burst: Node2D = SLASH_SPARKS.instantiate() # a new burst per cut: overlap (A3)
44		_slash_bursts.add_child(burst)
45		burst.global_position = _sword_box.global_position
46		burst.scale.x = _rudy.facing
47		(burst.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).finished.connect(burst.queue_free)
48		for emitter: GPUParticles2D in burst.get_children():
49			emitter.emitting = true
50	
51	
52	func _drive_run_dust() -> void:
53		# It follows him even when idle, so a respawn's jump lays down nothing (B5).
54		_run_dust.global_position = _rudy.global_position + RUN_DUST_OFFSET
55		var running := _rudy.mode == Rudy.Mode.PLAY and _rudy.is_on_floor() \
56				and absf(_rudy.velocity.x) > 1.0
57		var want := running and _run_dust.is_visible_in_tree() # hidden: no unseen puffs (B4)
58		if _run_dust.emitting != want:
59			_run_dust.emitting = want
60

class_name Spikes
extends Area2D
## A row of spikes (ENV-SPIKES). Touching them costs Rudy a heart. They check
## every physics tick, so standing on them hurts again once his invulnerability
## ends. The art is five iron spikes on a wooden plank, 106 px wide with the
## tips 63 px up, drawn at half scale from props.json's origin with the outer
## outline. The box that hurts covers the row of spikes (80 px), not the
## plank's ends, and stops 11 px below the tips, so a graze of a tip is a miss.
## Each row stands between two of the ground's tall wheat tufts, so no tuft
## shows behind it. The origin is at the middle of the plank, on the ground.

const WIDTH := 80.0 ## the box that hurts


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for body in get_overlapping_bodies():
		if body is Rudy:
			(body as Rudy).take_hit(global_position)

content.text:
I've read everything and changed nothing. One limit first: this session can't run shell commands (Bash was denied), so I ran no Godot command. Every measured value below comes from logs already committed in `evidence/` and `logs/`. Where I've only worked a number out from the code, I say so.

## 1. Where Rudy's gameplay state lives

**There are no animation nodes in the game.** A search of `game/` for `AnimationPlayer`, `AnimationTree`, `AnimatedSprite2D`, `Skeleton2D`, `Bone2D` and `AnimationLibrary` finds nothing. The only `AnimationPlayer`s in the folder are the probe fixtures in `evidence/brief-probe/tests/probe/g3/`, which aren't part of the game. So no animation key decides anything today.

**All of it is in `game/content/rudy/rudy.gd`.** Rudy's state is the script's own variables plus the body's physics:

| State | Where |
|---|---|
| `mode`: WAITING, PLAY, HURT, DEFEATED, FALLEN, RESPAWNING, CELEBRATING | enum `rudy.gd:40-48`, variable `:80` |
| `gear`, `hearts`, `facing`, `pose` | `:78-82` |
| Timers: `_run_clock`, `_turn_time_left`, `_respawn_time_left`, `_hurt_time_left`, `_invulnerable_left`, `_slash_clock` (below 0 means not swinging) | `:84-92` |
| Air-pose memory: `_was_falling`, `_falls_sideways`, `_bounce_pending` | `:89-91` |
| `velocity`, `is_on_floor()` (from CharacterBody2D) | written `:199-227` |

What he looks like is a copy of that state:
- `RudyLook.pose` and `_sprite.texture` are set by `show_pose()` (`rudy_look.gd:34`, `:39-46`).
- `Look.scale.x` follows `facing` and `Look.modulate.a` does the invulnerability flash (`rudy.gd:231-232`).

**Other scripts write his state too, through his methods:**
- `main.gd:82` sets WAITING and `:109` sets PLAY.
- `main.gd:120` calls `fall_out()`, `:128` calls `respawn_at()` and `:188` calls `celebrate()`.
- `goblin.gd:107` calls `bounce()`, and `goblin.gd:109` and `spikes.gd:18` call `take_hit()`.
- `sword_pickup.gd:49` calls `equip_sword()`.

**One thing to know:** `_pick_pose()` changes state as well as reading it. It sets `_run_clock`, `_was_falling` and `_falls_sideways` (`:299-310`).

## 2. What decides each state and transition

The order within one tick is in `_physics_process` (`rudy.gd:198-234`): input and facing, horizontal speed, gravity or jump, slash start, `move_and_slide`, `_swing`, the countdowns, then `_pick_pose` and `show_pose`.

**Mode transitions:**

| Transition | Decided at |
|---|---|
| WAITING → PLAY | `main.gd:106-109` (Enter on the title) |
| PLAY/HURT → HURT, or → DEFEATED at 0 hearts without the sword | `rudy.gd:129-153`; also cancels the swing (`:143`) |
| HURT → PLAY | `rudy.gd:265-268`, after `hurt_time` 0.35 s |
| PLAY → FALLEN | `main.gd:89-90` → `rudy.gd:167`; cancels the swing (`:168`) |
| FALLEN/DEFEATED → RESPAWNING | `main.gd:128` → `rudy.gd:177-190`; cancels the swing (`:182`), takes the sword (`:181`) |
| RESPAWNING → PLAY | `rudy.gd:269-273`, after `respawn_time` 0.7 s |
| PLAY → CELEBRATING | `main.gd:188` → `rudy.gd:193-195`; cancels the swing |

**Pose choice** is a priority list in `_pick_pose` (`rudy.gd:285-311`); the first match wins:
1. CELEBRATE, RESPAWN, DEFEAT or HURT, by `mode` (`:286-294`).
2. `CHAR-SWORD-SLASH` while `is_slashing()` (`:295-296`).
3. In the air (`:298-304`): FALL only if he's falling and was moving sideways (`|vx| > 1`) when the fall began; otherwise RISE. FALLEN mode lands here too.
4. RUN-A/RUN-B on the floor while `|vx| > 1`, using `fmod(_run_clock, 0.25) >= 0.125` (`:306-309`).
5. IDLE otherwise (`:310-311`). WAITING lands here.

States 3–5 use the `CHAR-SWORD-` frames while `gear == SWORD` (`:297`).

**The inputs behind those choices:**

| Action | Decided at |
|---|---|
| Jump | `rudy.gd:219-222`: a fresh press, on the floor, in PLAY |
| Slash start | `:223-226`: in PLAY, with the sword, not already swinging, a fresh press. It works in the air too |
| Slash end | `:248-251`: when `_slash_clock >= slash_time` |
| Hitbox live | `:241-242`: `0.03 <= clock <= 0.18`, read before the tick adds `delta` |
| Turn on the ground | `:204-208`: `vx` is zeroed and he waits `turn_hold_time` 0.12 s before moving |
| Run ↔ idle | `:212-215`: `move_toward` at 5600 px/s², about 93.3 px/s per tick |

**Hit order:** in `main.tscn`, `Level1` (the goblins and spikes) comes before `Rudy` (`:15`, `:21`). So a hit lands before his own tick runs, and that tick already shows `CHAR-HURT`.

## 3. Physics ticks per second: 60

`game/project.godot` doesn't set `physics/common/physics_ticks_per_second`, so the default of 60 holds. The committed probe printed `ticks/s 60` (`evidence/brief-probe/logs/slash_ticks_60fps_frame.log:3`). No script changes it: every use of `Engine.physics_ticks_per_second` in `game/` only reads it.

## 4. ANOMALIES (measured, kept, not fixed)

- **A1: the swing is 17 ticks, not 18.** `slash_time` 0.3 s reads as 18 ticks at 60/s. The probe shows the slash pose on ticks 0–16 and `CHAR-SWORD-IDLE` on tick 17 (`slash_ticks_60fps_frame.log:4-21`). The clock already moves forward on the tick of the press (`rudy.gd:225` and then `:249`), so after tick 17 it reaches 18/60.
- **A2: the existing swing-length check is loose.** `checks.gd:732` accepts `(swing_ticks + 2)/60` within ±2/60 s of 0.3 s, so it can't tell a 17-tick swing from an 18- or 19-tick one. That's the only reason it doesn't contradict A1. I'm noting it, not changing it.

The run cycle hasn't been measured yet. From the code I expect `RUN-A` to last 7 ticks first, because the clock moves forward before it's read (`:307-308`). After that, the cell lengths depend on how `fmod` rounds at multiples of 0.125 s. The pin will measure them. If they don't match the code, the measured values go in the test and on this list.

## 5. Proposal (1): the pin test, `game/tests/test_rudy_pin.tscn` + `test_rudy_pin.gd`

**The scene, laid out in the `.tscn` so the script never writes a position.** Hazards and the pickup come before Rudy, as in `main.tscn`:
```
PinTest (Node, test_rudy_pin.gd)
└── World (Node2D)
    ├── Floor     StaticBody2D, layer 1, 20000 × 100 rectangle, top at y 0
    ├── Pickup    sword_pickup.tscn at (-500, 0)    (mask 2, sword_pickup.tscn:11)
    ├── Spikes    spikes.tscn at (2500, 0)
    ├── Rudy      rudy.tscn at (0, 0)    (mode defaults to PLAY, rudy.gd:80)
    └── Recorder  Node, process_physics_priority 100, so it runs after Rudy each tick
```
There's no `Main`, so no title, camera or music.

**Driving it:**
- Input is only `InputEventKey` with `physical_keycode` D, A, Space or J, sent through `Input.parse_input_event`.
- The script steps with `await get_tree().process_frame`, one frame per step at `--fixed-fps 60`, so one tick per step. An event sent right after the await is read on the next tick, which the test calls tick 0 (`slash_ticks_60fps_frame.log:4`).
- A tap is a key-down and then a key-up on the next frame.
- It never calls Rudy's or `RudyLook`'s methods, never writes velocity, position or game state, and never resets `Sfx`: it reads `Sfx.count(&"slash")` as before-and-after differences.

**Per-tick log line** from the Recorder: tick, `mode`, `pose`, `velocity`, `is_on_floor()`, `_slash_clock`, `SwordHitbox/Shape.disabled`, `facing`, `gear`. Every check is computed from these samples.

**The script:**
1. Wait 10 frames to settle.
2. Run right without the sword for 60 ticks, release, stop.
3. Jump in place.
4. Hold A until `gear == SWORD`, then turn right.
5. Single slash, then presses on swing ticks 1, 2, 10, 11, 16, 17 and 18.
6. Jumps pressed on swing ticks 1, 5 and 12.
7. Run, slash, run while holding D.
8. Hold D into the spikes, with J pressed on the way, then wait out HURT.

Bounded waits use conditions read from the samples. A wait that times out is a FAIL.

**Output:** results are collected and printed in two blocks, `== TIMING ==` and `== INVARIANT ==`, as `PASS/FAIL  T<n>/I<n> <what>  (<measured>)`, then a summary line. It exits 1 on any FAIL.

**TIMING** (numbers you may change on purpose):

| # | Line |
|---|---|
| T1 | Run without the sword, from a standstill: first run tick = the press tick; the measured A/B cell lengths over 60 run ticks (predicted: A 7 ticks first) |
| T2 | The same with the sword (`CHAR-SWORD-RUN-A/B`) |
| T3 | Slash pose on swing ticks 0–16, 17 ticks; first `CHAR-SWORD-IDLE` on tick 17 |
| T4 | Hitbox live on swing ticks 2–10 |
| T5 | A press read on tick 17 is ignored; one read on tick 18 starts a new swing |
| T6 | Run phase after a slash: the run cell and how long it has left after tick 17 match where `_run_clock` stood before the swing (it resumes today) |
| T7 | Run → idle after releasing D: number of ticks until `CHAR-IDLE` |
| T8 | Turn on the ground: number of idle ticks before the run starts |
| T9 | HURT lasts N ticks (0.35 s is about 21) |

**INVARIANT** (facts that must survive any change):

| # | Line |
|---|---|
| I1 | Every tick the hitbox is live, the pose is `CHAR-SWORD-SLASH`; each swing has exactly one dead→live edge and 9 live ticks |
